courses.title: Boeing 787 複材與電力系統
courses.summary: 以二十四個設計審查任務連結材料、機身接合、更多電力架構與試驗證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twenty-four design-review tasks connect materials, fuselage joins, more-electric architecture and test evidence.
courses.scope: 以公開資料建立的概念工程課程，練習件、載荷與數字均為教學假設。不是波音製造圖、維修指令、飛行操作或適航放行程序。
courses.scopeEn: A conceptual engineering course based on public sources; specimens, loads and numbers are teaching assumptions. It is not Boeing manufacturing data, maintenance instructions, flight procedures or an airworthiness release process.

stages.title: 需求與材料邊界
stages.description: 把航程與重量需求轉成可追溯的結構問題。
stages.descriptionEn: Translate range and mass needs into traceable structural questions.
stages.route: 先完成前置學習，再提交圖解、推理與檢核證據；每一步均為原創教育任務。
stages.routeEn: Complete the prerequisites, then submit diagrams, reasoning and review evidence; each step is an original educational exercise.

steps.title: 建立任務與重量權衡圖
steps.titleEn: Build a mission and mass trade map
steps.objective: 分清航程、酬載與能源需求。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish range, payload and energy demands.
steps.instruction: 列出假想航線的距離與酬載；畫出空機、酬載與燃油三格；調高其中一格並記錄其他限制。
steps.instructionEn: List distance and payload for an imaginary route; draw empty-mass, payload and fuel boxes; increase one and record the other constraints.
steps.observation: 航程目標牽動結構重量與攜帶能源。
steps.observationEn: A range target couples structural mass to carried energy.
steps.failure: 只比較座位數會漏掉任務差異。
steps.failureEn: Comparing seat counts alone misses mission differences.
steps.check: 交出有單位、假設及兩個權衡方案的表。
steps.checkEn: Submit a table with units, assumptions and two trade alternatives.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 重量預算是跨系統分配，某一部件減重不等於相同幅度的全機油耗改善。
knowledge.textEn: A mass budget spans systems; a component mass reduction does not imply an equal percentage aircraft fuel reduction.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 酬載、攜帶能源與結構質量相互耦合；比較航線時要固定氣象與保留量假設。
knowledge.textEn: Payload, carried energy and structural mass are coupled; route comparisons need consistent weather and reserve assumptions.

quiz.question: 針對「建立任務與重量權衡圖」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Build a mission and mass trade map’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 同時列出任務與質量假設
只看最多座位數
把所有 787 型號視為同一性能
optionsEn: State mission and mass assumptions together
Use maximum seat count alone
Treat every 787 variant as identical
quiz.explanation: 重量預算是跨系統分配，某一部件減重不等於相同幅度的全機油耗改善。 酬載、攜帶能源與結構質量相互耦合；比較航線時要固定氣象與保留量假設。
quiz.explanationEn: A mass budget spans systems; a component mass reduction does not imply an equal percentage aircraft fuel reduction. Payload, carried energy and structural mass are coupled; route comparisons need consistent weather and reserve assumptions.

steps.title: 畫出機身與機翼載荷路徑
steps.titleEn: Trace fuselage and wing load paths
steps.objective: 把外力連到承載結構。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect external forces to load-carrying structure.
steps.instruction: 在原創側視圖標重力與升力；沿機翼盒、接頭與機身畫反力；再加入客艙壓差並用另一顏色標示。
steps.instructionEn: Mark gravity and lift on an original side view; trace reactions through wing box, joints and fuselage; add cabin pressure using a different color.
steps.observation: 同一接頭可能承受多種載荷。
steps.observationEn: A joint may carry several load components.
steps.failure: 把蒙皮當裝飾會切斷載荷路徑。
steps.failureEn: Treating skin as decorative breaks the load path.
steps.check: 每個外力都要有連續的反力路徑。
steps.checkEn: Every external load needs a continuous reaction path.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 平衡條件是力與力矩守恆，並不單獨證明剛度、疲勞或穩定性。
knowledge.textEn: Force and moment equilibrium alone do not establish stiffness, fatigue resistance or stability.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 機身框、長桁與蒙皮分擔承載；簡圖省略了真實接頭細節。
knowledge.textEn: Frames, stringers and skin share loads; a schematic omits actual joint details.

quiz.question: 針對「畫出機身與機翼載荷路徑」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Trace fuselage and wing load paths’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 只需計算重量而不考慮壓差
需要追蹤力與力矩的傳遞
箭頭終止在外觀表面即可
optionsEn: Consider weight but ignore pressure
Trace both forces and moments
End arrows at the outer appearance
quiz.explanation: 平衡條件是力與力矩守恆，並不單獨證明剛度、疲勞或穩定性。 機身框、長桁與蒙皮分擔承載；簡圖省略了真實接頭細節。
quiz.explanationEn: Force and moment equilibrium alone do not establish stiffness, fatigue resistance or stability. Frames, stringers and skin share loads; a schematic omits actual joint details.

steps.title: 辨識層合板方向性
steps.objective: 理解纖維方向如何改變剛度。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand how fiber orientation changes stiffness.
steps.instruction: 畫兩片等厚試片；一片纖維平行拉力、一片垂直；再加入斜向層並預測剪切反應。
steps.instructionEn: Draw two equal-thickness coupons; align fibers with the load in one and across it in the other; add angled plies and predict shear response.
steps.observation: 等厚材料未必有相同方向剛度。
steps.observationEn: Equal thickness does not imply equal directional stiffness.
steps.failure: 把複材當各向同性金屬會誤判。
steps.failureEn: Treating composites as isotropic metal misleads.
steps.check: 說明至少兩個方向的負載差異。
steps.checkEn: Explain loading differences in at least two directions.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 纖維、樹脂與鋪層共同決定層合板行為，不能只引用單一纖維強度。
knowledge.textEn: Fibers, matrix and stacking jointly determine laminate behavior; fiber strength alone is insufficient.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 橫向與層間行為更依賴基材和介面；沿纖維強度高不能代表所有方向都同樣強。
knowledge.textEn: Transverse and interlaminar behavior depend more on matrix and interfaces; high fiber-direction strength does not imply equal strength everywhere.

quiz.question: 針對「辨識層合板方向性」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Identify laminate directionality’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 同厚度必然同強度
只要增加樹脂就一定更強
應比較鋪層與載荷方向
optionsEn: Equal thickness guarantees equal strength
More resin always means stronger material
Compare stacking with load direction
quiz.explanation: 纖維、樹脂與鋪層共同決定層合板行為，不能只引用單一纖維強度。 橫向與層間行為更依賴基材和介面；沿纖維強度高不能代表所有方向都同樣強。
quiz.explanationEn: Fibers, matrix and stacking jointly determine laminate behavior; fiber strength alone is insufficient. Transverse and interlaminar behavior depend more on matrix and interfaces; high fiber-direction strength does not imply equal strength everywhere.

steps.title: 建立材料批次追溯卡
steps.objective: 讓材料身分連到試件與紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect material identity to specimens and records.
steps.instruction: 為兩個假想批次編號；記錄收料、儲存與出庫事件；把每張教學試片連回批次並標出缺資料處。
steps.instructionEn: Number two hypothetical lots; record receipt, storage and issue events; link each teaching coupon to a lot and flag missing data.
steps.observation: 外觀相同不代表材料履歷相同。
steps.observationEn: Similar appearance does not establish identical history.
steps.failure: 把失去標籤的試片重新猜成某批次會破壞追溯。
steps.failureEn: Guessing a lost coupon identity breaks traceability.
steps.check: 從試片能回查批次，從批次能找到全部試片。
steps.checkEn: Trace specimens to lots and lots to all their specimens.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 材料狀態包含時間與環境歷程，不是只有供應商名稱。
knowledge.textEn: Material state includes time and environmental history, not just supplier name.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 追溯能界定受影響範圍，但不能取代材料本身的驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Traceability identifies affected scope but does not replace material verification.

quiz.question: 針對「建立材料批次追溯卡」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Build material-lot traceability’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 未知資料應明確標示與隔離審查
可用相似外觀補寫批號
總裝後不必保留批次關係
optionsEn: Flag unknown data for separate review
Infer lot identity from appearance
Discard lot links after assembly
quiz.explanation: 材料狀態包含時間與環境歷程，不是只有供應商名稱。 追溯能界定受影響範圍，但不能取代材料本身的驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: Material state includes time and environmental history, not just supplier name. Traceability identifies affected scope but does not replace material verification.

steps.title: 規劃製造與檢測分工
steps.objective: 區分做出零件與證明零件合格。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate making a part from proving conformity.
steps.instruction: 畫供應商、加工、檢驗與總裝四站；為每站指定輸入證據；加入不合格返工路徑並檢查版本回流。
steps.instructionEn: Draw supplier, fabrication, inspection and assembly stations; assign input evidence to each; add a nonconformance loop and inspect revision feedback.
steps.observation: 品質證據需要隨零件一起交接。
steps.observationEn: Quality evidence must travel with the part.
steps.failure: 只安排物流而沒有文件介面容易漏驗。
steps.failureEn: Logistics without documentation interfaces can omit inspections.
steps.check: 列出每個交接點的零件身分與可接受證據。
steps.checkEn: Identify part identity and acceptable evidence at every handoff.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 分散製造可並行工作，但把介面控制、運輸保護與一致性問題放大。
knowledge.textEn: Distributed manufacture enables parallel work but magnifies interface, transport-protection and consistency challenges.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 返工會改變狀態；舊檢驗結果不能自動覆蓋修改後配置。
knowledge.textEn: Rework changes state; old inspection results do not automatically cover a modified configuration.

quiz.question: 針對「規劃製造與檢測分工」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Plan production and inspection roles’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 返工後可永遠沿用舊證明
交付必須含配置與檢測證據
運到總裝線即代表品質合格
optionsEn: Reuse old evidence indefinitely after rework
Deliver configuration and inspection evidence
Arrival at assembly proves conformity
quiz.explanation: 分散製造可並行工作，但把介面控制、運輸保護與一致性問題放大。 返工會改變狀態；舊檢驗結果不能自動覆蓋修改後配置。
quiz.explanationEn: Distributed manufacture enables parallel work but magnifies interface, transport-protection and consistency challenges. Rework changes state; old inspection results do not automatically cover a modified configuration.

steps.title: 建立需求—驗證矩陣
steps.objective: 為不同主張選擇正確證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Select appropriate evidence for different claims.
steps.instruction: 寫下質量、尺寸與承載三項假想要求；分配量測、分析或試驗方法；列出無法僅靠外觀證明的項目。
steps.instructionEn: Write hypothetical mass, dimensional and load requirements; assign measurement, analysis or test; list claims that appearance alone cannot establish.
steps.observation: 漂亮模型與可驗證工程是不同產物。
steps.observationEn: An attractive model and verified engineering are different outputs.
steps.failure: 把所有欄位都填「目視通過」沒有意義。
steps.failureEn: Marking every field as visual pass is uninformative.
steps.check: 每項要求有條件、方法與結果欄位。
steps.checkEn: Every requirement has conditions, a method and a result field.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 驗證問題是是否符合要求；確認用途則問要求是否解決正確任務。
knowledge.textEn: Verification asks whether requirements are met; validation asks whether those requirements address the right mission.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 未測項目應保留為未決，不能由其他通過項目推定。
knowledge.textEn: Untested items remain open; unrelated passes do not close them.

quiz.question: 針對「建立需求—驗證矩陣」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Build a requirement–verification matrix’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 漂亮外觀能證明承載
有一項通過即可全部放行
尺寸與承載需要不同的證據
optionsEn: Appearance proves load capability
One pass releases every requirement
Dimensions and load capability need different evidence
quiz.explanation: 驗證問題是是否符合要求；確認用途則問要求是否解決正確任務。 未測項目應保留為未決，不能由其他通過項目推定。
quiz.explanationEn: Verification asks whether requirements are met; validation asks whether those requirements address the right mission. Untested items remain open; unrelated passes do not close them.

stages.title: 複材製程與接合證據
stages.description: 用教學試片了解層合、成形、缺陷與接合。
stages.descriptionEn: Use teaching coupons to understand laminates, forming, defects and joints.
stages.route: 先完成前置學習，再提交圖解、推理與檢核證據；每一步均為原創教育任務。
stages.routeEn: Complete the prerequisites, then submit diagrams, reasoning and review evidence; each step is an original educational exercise.

steps.title: 比較鋪層對稱與翹曲
steps.objective: 把堆疊順序連到熱變形。
steps.objectiveEn: Link stacking order to thermal deformation.
steps.instruction: 畫對稱與不對稱層序；標每層方向；以紙片示意受熱後的彎曲可能性並註記只是類比。
steps.instructionEn: Draw symmetric and asymmetric stacks; mark ply directions; use paper to illustrate possible thermal curvature and label the analogy.
steps.observation: 相同材料用量仍可能有不同耦合行為。
steps.observationEn: Equal material amounts may have different coupling behavior.
steps.failure: 把紙模型變形量當真實碳纖維數值不成立。
steps.failureEn: Paper curvature is not a carbon-composite measurement.
steps.check: 解釋層序與總厚度各自影響什麼。
steps.checkEn: Explain the distinct effects of stacking and total thickness.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 不對稱層合可使面內負載與彎曲耦合；對稱並不自動保證所有性能合格。
knowledge.textEn: Unsymmetric laminates can couple in-plane loads to bending; symmetry alone does not ensure all requirements are met.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 熱膨脹、工具約束與固化收縮都可能影響成形幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal expansion, tooling constraints and cure shrinkage can all affect final geometry.

quiz.question: 針對「比較鋪層對稱與翹曲」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Compare layup symmetry and warping’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 比較層序而非只比較厚度
只要厚度相同就不會翹曲
紙模型可給出飛機零件公差
optionsEn: Compare stacking as well as thickness
Equal thickness prevents warping
A paper model specifies aircraft tolerances
quiz.explanation: 不對稱層合可使面內負載與彎曲耦合；對稱並不自動保證所有性能合格。 熱膨脹、工具約束與固化收縮都可能影響成形幾何。
quiz.explanationEn: Unsymmetric laminates can couple in-plane loads to bending; symmetry alone does not ensure all requirements are met. Thermal expansion, tooling constraints and cure shrinkage can all affect final geometry.

steps.title: 標記鋪帶間隙與重疊
steps.objective: 辨認製程缺陷對幾何的影響。
steps.objectiveEn: Recognize process defects affecting geometry.
steps.instruction: 在示意鋪帶圖標出間隙、重疊與轉向；用同一比例尺比較面積；寫出需要檢查的位置而不自行訂適航允收值。
steps.instructionEn: Mark gaps, overlaps and turns in a tape schematic; compare areas at one scale; identify inspection locations without inventing airworthiness limits.
steps.observation: 局部增厚與樹脂區可能出現在不同位置。
steps.observationEn: Local thickening and resin-rich regions may occur separately.
steps.failure: 只看總覆蓋率會漏掉集中缺陷。
steps.failureEn: Overall coverage can hide clustered defects.
steps.check: 提交缺陷位置圖與待查設計依據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a defect-location map and required design references.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 幾何不連續可能改變局部纖維方向與載荷傳遞。
knowledge.textEn: Geometric discontinuities may change local fiber orientation and load transfer.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 允收取決於材料、位置與核准工程依據，不能由課程圖決定。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance depends on material, location and approved engineering data, not this illustration.

quiz.question: 針對「標記鋪帶間隙與重疊」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Mark layup gaps and overlaps’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 任意修補就能恢復核准狀態
缺陷的位置和形態都重要
覆蓋率高即可忽略局部缺陷
optionsEn: Any patch restores approval
Defect location and shape both matter
High coverage permits all local defects
quiz.explanation: 幾何不連續可能改變局部纖維方向與載荷傳遞。 允收取決於材料、位置與核准工程依據，不能由課程圖決定。
quiz.explanationEn: Geometric discontinuities may change local fiber orientation and load transfer. Acceptance depends on material, location and approved engineering data, not this illustration.

steps.title: 檢查工具面與定位基準
steps.objective: 避免把量測座標系混在一起。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid mixing measurement frames.
steps.instruction: 在模具圖定義基準面與兩軸；把三個測點投影至同一座標系；再改一個基準並比較報表變化。
steps.instructionEn: Define a datum plane and two axes on a mold sketch; project three points into that frame; change a datum and compare reports.
steps.observation: 不同基準可讓同一件看起來不同。
steps.observationEn: Different datums can make one part appear different.
steps.failure: 比較沒有基準註記的數字會誤判。
steps.failureEn: Numbers without datum definitions mislead comparisons.
steps.check: 所有測點都附座標框架與單位。
steps.checkEn: Attach a frame and units to every point.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 基準建立可重複的幾何參考，不等於工具永遠不會熱變形。
knowledge.textEn: Datums establish repeatable geometry references, not thermally invariant tooling.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 工具、零件與量測裝置各有不確定度，應分開列帳。
knowledge.textEn: Tooling, parts and instruments have separate uncertainties that should be accounted for.

quiz.question: 針對「檢查工具面與定位基準」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Review tooling and datums’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 座標數字越多越準
工具基準不需記錄
先統一基準再比較量測
optionsEn: More coordinate digits guarantee accuracy
Tool datums need no record
Unify datums before comparing measurements
quiz.explanation: 基準建立可重複的幾何參考，不等於工具永遠不會熱變形。 工具、零件與量測裝置各有不確定度，應分開列帳。
quiz.explanationEn: Datums establish repeatable geometry references, not thermally invariant tooling. Tooling, parts and instruments have separate uncertainties that should be accounted for.

steps.title: 閱讀固化歷程而不配製配方
steps.titleEn: Read cure histories without prescribing a recipe
steps.objective: 辨認歷程資料與合格判定的關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Relate history records to conformity decisions.
steps.instruction: 畫無量綱的溫度與時間示意；標感測器位置、資料空缺與升降段；比較兩條歷程並提出待查問題。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a dimensionless temperature-time sketch; mark sensor positions, gaps and ramps; compare two histories and list questions for review.
steps.observation: 單一最高溫度無法描述整段歷程。
steps.observationEn: A peak temperature does not describe a full history.
steps.failure: 將教學曲線當真實固化設定會誤用。
steps.failureEn: Treating the teaching curve as a production cure schedule is misuse.
steps.check: 說明為何需要位置、時間與材料對應。
steps.checkEn: Explain why location, time and material identity matter.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 固化涉及樹脂反應、熱傳與壓實，過程證據應連回特定材料系統。
knowledge.textEn: Cure involves resin reaction, heat transfer and consolidation; evidence must link to a particular material system.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 感測點量到的是局部歷程，厚度與熱邊界差異可能造成零件內部溫度梯度；代表性須另驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Sensors record local histories; thickness and thermal boundaries can create internal gradients, so representativeness needs verification.

quiz.question: 針對「閱讀固化歷程而不配製配方」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Read cure histories without prescribing a recipe’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 完整歷程比單一峰值更有資訊
最高溫相同就完全等效
任一教學曲線可套用所有樹脂
optionsEn: Full histories carry more information than peaks
Equal peak temperatures mean equivalence
One teaching curve suits every resin
quiz.explanation: 固化涉及樹脂反應、熱傳與壓實，過程證據應連回特定材料系統。 感測點量到的是局部歷程，厚度與熱邊界差異可能造成零件內部溫度梯度；代表性須另驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: Cure involves resin reaction, heat transfer and consolidation; evidence must link to a particular material system. Sensors record local histories; thickness and thermal boundaries can create internal gradients, so representativeness needs verification.

steps.title: 比較非破壞檢測訊號
steps.objective: 把可見表面與內部缺陷分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate surface appearance from internal defects.
steps.instruction: 畫完好與疑似分層的教學截面；為每個截面配一條虛構回波；列出參考試塊與訊號不確定因素。
steps.instructionEn: Draw sound and suspected-delamination sections; attach invented echo traces; list reference-block and uncertainty factors.
steps.observation: 訊號差異需要校準與幾何背景。
steps.observationEn: Signal differences need calibration and geometry context.
steps.failure: 把每個回波都當缺陷會誤報。
steps.failureEn: Treating every echo as a defect creates false alarms.
steps.check: 指出一個可能真缺陷與一個幾何干擾。
steps.checkEn: Identify a possible defect and a geometric confounder.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 非破壞檢測仍有可偵測性限制；沒有指示不等於不存在任何缺陷。
knowledge.textEn: Nondestructive inspection has detection limits; no indication does not prove the absence of every defect.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 參考試件讓設備響應與材料幾何建立對照；參考件與受檢區差異越大，判讀適用性越需審查。
knowledge.textEn: Reference specimens connect instrument response with geometry and material; larger differences from inspected regions require closer applicability review.

quiz.question: 針對「比較非破壞檢測訊號」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Compare nondestructive inspection signals’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 任何回波都代表分層
判讀需要參考件與位置資訊
表面平整證明內部無缺陷
optionsEn: Every echo is delamination
Interpretation needs references and location
A smooth surface proves no internal defect
quiz.explanation: 非破壞檢測仍有可偵測性限制；沒有指示不等於不存在任何缺陷。 參考試件讓設備響應與材料幾何建立對照；參考件與受檢區差異越大，判讀適用性越需審查。
quiz.explanationEn: Nondestructive inspection has detection limits; no indication does not prove the absence of every defect. Reference specimens connect instrument response with geometry and material; larger differences from inspected regions require closer applicability review.

steps.title: 分析複材接頭的載荷轉移
steps.titleEn: Analyze load transfer in composite joints
steps.objective: 區分接頭整體力與局部應力。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish overall joint force from local stress.
steps.instruction: 畫簡化搭接與對接兩種模型；標出剪力、承壓與偏心；比較改變接合長度的可能影響。
steps.instructionEn: Draw simplified lap and butt joints; mark shear, bearing and eccentricity; compare possible effects of changing joint length.
steps.observation: 受力可能集中於接頭端部。
steps.observationEn: Loads may concentrate near joint ends.
steps.failure: 把平均應力當所有位置應力會漏判。
steps.failureEn: Treating average stress as local stress misses concentrations.
steps.check: 交出載荷路徑與一個偏心造成的問題。
steps.checkEn: Submit a load path and one eccentricity-related issue.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 膠接、機械接合與混合接頭具有不同失效模式，不能只用接合面積比較。
knowledge.textEn: Bonded, mechanical and hybrid joints have different failure modes; area alone is insufficient.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 偏心搭接會引入彎曲與剝離效應，增加接合長度不保證端部應力按同一比例下降。
knowledge.textEn: Eccentric lap joints introduce bending and peel; increasing overlap does not guarantee proportional reduction in end stresses.

quiz.question: 針對「分析複材接頭的載荷轉移」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Analyze load transfer in composite joints’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 平均應力即可預測所有失效
接合面積加倍保證強度加倍
接頭需檢查局部與整體行為
optionsEn: Average stress predicts every failure
Doubling area guarantees double strength
Review both local and overall joint behavior
quiz.explanation: 膠接、機械接合與混合接頭具有不同失效模式，不能只用接合面積比較。 偏心搭接會引入彎曲與剝離效應，增加接合長度不保證端部應力按同一比例下降。
quiz.explanationEn: Bonded, mechanical and hybrid joints have different failure modes; area alone is insufficient. Eccentric lap joints introduce bending and peel; increasing overlap does not guarantee proportional reduction in end stresses.

stages.title: 總裝與機電整合
stages.description: 分開幾何介面、電力供應、散熱與資料責任。
stages.descriptionEn: Separate geometry, power, cooling and data responsibilities.
stages.route: 先完成前置學習，再提交圖解、推理與檢核證據；每一步均為原創教育任務。
stages.routeEn: Complete the prerequisites, then submit diagrams, reasoning and review evidence; each step is an original educational exercise.

steps.title: 對齊機身段的共同座標
steps.titleEn: Align fuselage sections in a common frame
steps.objective: 理解大型總裝的幾何介面。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand geometry interfaces in large assembly.
steps.instruction: 畫兩段圓筒與各自基準；轉成共同軸線；加入平移、傾角兩種偏差並分別記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Draw two cylinders with local datums; transform to a common axis; introduce translation and tilt and record them separately.
steps.observation: 角度偏差隨距離放大為位置偏差。
steps.observationEn: Angular errors grow into positional errors over distance.
steps.failure: 只對齊一個點不能確定整段姿態。
steps.failureEn: Aligning one point cannot define a whole section attitude.
steps.check: 用三個不共線參考點說明姿態。
steps.checkEn: Explain attitude using three non-collinear references.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 大型零件對接同時管理位置與姿態；局部貼合不代表整體軸線一致。
knowledge.textEn: Large-part mating controls position and attitude; local contact does not establish global alignment.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 剛體模型忽略零件彈性，實際量測應考慮支撐與溫度。
knowledge.textEn: A rigid model omits elasticity; real metrology must consider support and temperature.

quiz.question: 針對「對齊機身段的共同座標」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Align fuselage sections in a common frame’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 需要共同基準及姿態資訊
接觸一點即完全對齊
可忽略支撐造成變形
optionsEn: Use common datums and attitude information
One touching point proves alignment
Support deformation is irrelevant
quiz.explanation: 大型零件對接同時管理位置與姿態；局部貼合不代表整體軸線一致。 剛體模型忽略零件彈性，實際量測應考慮支撐與溫度。
quiz.explanationEn: Large-part mating controls position and attitude; local contact does not establish global alignment. A rigid model omits elasticity; real metrology must consider support and temperature.

steps.title: 建立公差與不確定度預算
steps.objective: 分開設計範圍與量測能力。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate design allowance from measurement capability.
steps.instruction: 給三個教學尺寸各一個假設範圍；計算最差方向疊加；另列儀器不確定度並說明不能混稱公差。
steps.instructionEn: Assign assumed ranges to three dimensions; sum worst-case directions; list instrument uncertainty separately and explain the distinction.
steps.observation: 名義尺寸吻合不保證所有組合可裝配。
steps.observationEn: Matching nominal dimensions does not guarantee assembly in every combination.
steps.failure: 把量測解析度當不確定度不成立。
steps.failureEn: Display resolution is not measurement uncertainty.
steps.check: 保留名義值、允許範圍及量測不確定度三欄。
steps.checkEn: Keep nominal value, allowance and uncertainty in separate columns.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 公差是設計容許範圍，不確定度是對測量結果的認識限制。
knowledge.textEn: Tolerance is a design allowance; uncertainty describes limits of knowledge about a measurement.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 統計疊加要有分布與相關性假設，不能盲目替代最差情境。
knowledge.textEn: Statistical stacks need distribution and correlation assumptions and cannot blindly replace worst-case analysis.

quiz.question: 針對「建立公差與不確定度預算」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Build tolerance and uncertainty budgets’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 所有尺寸誤差一定互相抵消
公差與不確定度應分列
顯示更多小數即可保證裝配
optionsEn: All dimensional errors cancel
List tolerance and uncertainty separately
More displayed decimals guarantee assembly
quiz.explanation: 公差是設計容許範圍，不確定度是對測量結果的認識限制。 統計疊加要有分布與相關性假設，不能盲目替代最差情境。
quiz.explanationEn: Tolerance is a design allowance; uncertainty describes limits of knowledge about a measurement. Statistical stacks need distribution and correlation assumptions and cannot blindly replace worst-case analysis.

steps.title: 辨識異材接觸與雷擊路徑
steps.titleEn: Identify material interfaces and lightning paths
steps.objective: 把環境保護連到結構與導電介面。
steps.objectiveEn: Link environmental protection to structural and conductive interfaces.
steps.instruction: 標示碳纖維與金屬接合處；另畫示意電流路徑；圈出需查隔離、搭接與檢驗證據的地方。
steps.instructionEn: Mark carbon-fiber–metal interfaces; draw a separate illustrative current path; circle locations needing isolation, bonding and inspection evidence.
steps.observation: 機械接合與電氣連續性不能互相代替。
steps.observationEn: Mechanical attachment and electrical continuity are different properties.
steps.failure: 以外觀漆面判定防雷能力會誤導。
steps.failureEn: Paint appearance cannot establish lightning protection.
steps.check: 區分腐蝕問題與瞬態導電問題。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish corrosion from transient-current problems.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 異材接觸可能引入電化學腐蝕條件；防護設計需要環境與材料相容性評估。
knowledge.textEn: Dissimilar materials can create galvanic conditions; protection needs environmental and compatibility assessment.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 導電路徑的不連續可能造成局部電位差與發熱；機械牢固不能替代電气連續性證據。
knowledge.textEn: Discontinuous conducting paths can create local potential differences and heating; mechanical attachment does not establish electrical continuity.

quiz.question: 針對「辨識異材接觸與雷擊路徑」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Identify material interfaces and lightning paths’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 有金屬螺栓就完成全部防雷
碳纖維不必考虑電性
分別檢查材料相容性與導電路徑
optionsEn: Metal bolts complete all lightning protection
Carbon composites have no electrical considerations
Check compatibility and current paths separately
quiz.explanation: 異材接觸可能引入電化學腐蝕條件；防護設計需要環境與材料相容性評估。 導電路徑的不連續可能造成局部電位差與發熱；機械牢固不能替代電气連續性證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Dissimilar materials can create galvanic conditions; protection needs environmental and compatibility assessment. Discontinuous conducting paths can create local potential differences and heating; mechanical attachment does not establish electrical continuity.

steps.title: 拆解更多電力架構
steps.objective: 理解來源、匯流排與負載分工。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand sources, buses and load allocation.
steps.instruction: 畫發電來源、轉換器與三組教學負載；以不同色標示獨立通道；移除一個來源後檢查哪些功能仍有供應。
steps.instructionEn: Draw sources, converters and three teaching loads; color independent channels; remove one source and inspect remaining supplied functions.
steps.observation: 冗餘需要避免共用單點故障。
steps.observationEn: Redundancy must avoid shared single-point failures.
steps.failure: 畫兩條線但共用同一失效點不是有效獨立。
steps.failureEn: Two lines sharing one failure point are not effectively independent.
steps.check: 標出正常與單點故障下的功能狀態。
steps.checkEn: Mark functional states in normal and single-failure cases.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 更多電力架構把部分功能的能源需求轉給電系，也提高轉換與熱管理的重要性。
knowledge.textEn: More-electric architecture shifts some energy demands to electrical systems and raises conversion and thermal-management importance.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 故障後可維持的功能取決於剩餘來源能力與負載優先序；備援數量不能取代功率平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Retained functions after failure depend on remaining source capacity and load priorities; backup count cannot replace power balance.

quiz.question: 針對「拆解更多電力架構」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Decompose more-electric architecture’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 檢查兩通道是否共享失效點
所有負載都可任意接同一來源
線條數量就是可靠度
optionsEn: Check channels for shared failure points
Arbitrarily connect every load to one source
Line count alone determines reliability
quiz.explanation: 更多電力架構把部分功能的能源需求轉給電系，也提高轉換與熱管理的重要性。 故障後可維持的功能取決於剩餘來源能力與負載優先序；備援數量不能取代功率平衡。
quiz.explanationEn: More-electric architecture shifts some energy demands to electrical systems and raises conversion and thermal-management importance. Retained functions after failure depend on remaining source capacity and load priorities; backup count cannot replace power balance.

steps.title: 連結電力損失與散熱
steps.objective: 把效率與熱流納入同一預算。
steps.objectiveEn: Include efficiency and heat flow in one budget.
steps.instruction: 為假想轉換器設定輸入與輸出功率；相減得到損失；把熱流箭頭連至冷卻介面並註明例子非機型數據。
steps.instructionEn: Assign hypothetical converter input and output powers; subtract for loss; connect heat arrows to a cooling interface and label the example non-aircraft-specific.
steps.observation: 電力沒有消失，損失多轉成熱。
steps.observationEn: Electrical losses often become heat rather than disappearing.
steps.failure: 把效率百分比直接當瓦數是單位錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Treating an efficiency percentage as watts is a unit error.
steps.check: 完成輸入等於輸出加損失的平衡。
steps.checkEn: Close input = output + loss.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 效率需指定負載條件；高效率不代表在高功率下可忽略散熱。
knowledge.textEn: Efficiency needs a load condition; high efficiency does not make cooling negligible at high power.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 熱界面能力還受溫差、流阻與環境條件限制。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal interfaces also depend on temperature differences, flow resistance and environment.

quiz.question: 針對「連結電力損失與散熱」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Connect electrical losses to cooling’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 輸出功率一定大於輸入
仍需依實際損失量設計散熱
效率高於九成就完全不發熱
optionsEn: Output must exceed input
Size cooling for actual losses
Above ninety percent efficiency means no heat
quiz.explanation: 效率需指定負載條件；高效率不代表在高功率下可忽略散熱。 熱界面能力還受溫差、流阻與環境條件限制。
quiz.explanationEn: Efficiency needs a load condition; high efficiency does not make cooling negligible at high power. Thermal interfaces also depend on temperature differences, flow resistance and environment.

steps.title: 審查資料介面與故障隔離
steps.titleEn: Review data interfaces and fault isolation
steps.objective: 讓控制資訊有明確來源與時效。
steps.objectiveEn: Give control information explicit origin and freshness.
steps.instruction: 建立教學感測資料表，含單位與時間戳；模擬延遲及失聯；替每種狀況定義待查訊息與降級狀態。
steps.instructionEn: Create a teaching sensor table with units and timestamps; simulate delay and loss; define review messages and degraded states for each.
steps.observation: 數值合理仍可能是過期資料。
steps.observationEn: A plausible value may still be stale.
steps.failure: 只驗證資料有到達會漏掉語意錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Arrival checks alone miss semantic errors.
steps.check: 逐欄核對單位、時基、來源與失效狀態。
steps.checkEn: Check units, timebase, origin and failure state for each field.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 介面契約同時包含格式、時序與失效行為。
knowledge.textEn: An interface contract includes format, timing and failure behavior.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 故障隔離需要獨立證據，不能讓同一錯誤訊號自我證明正確。
knowledge.textEn: Fault isolation needs independent evidence; one faulty signal cannot certify itself.

quiz.question: 針對「審查資料介面與故障隔離」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Review data interfaces and fault isolation’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 收到任意數字即代表正常
延遲永遠不影響控制
時效與單位也是介面要求
optionsEn: Any received number proves health
Delay never affects control
Freshness and units are interface requirements
quiz.explanation: 介面契約同時包含格式、時序與失效行為。 故障隔離需要獨立證據，不能讓同一錯誤訊號自我證明正確。
quiz.explanationEn: An interface contract includes format, timing and failure behavior. Fault isolation needs independent evidence; one faulty signal cannot certify itself.

stages.title: 驗證、可靠度與交付
stages.description: 讓每項設計主張都能指向合適的試驗證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Link each design claim to appropriate test evidence.
stages.route: 先完成前置學習，再提交圖解、推理與檢核證據；每一步均為原創教育任務。
stages.routeEn: Complete the prerequisites, then submit diagrams, reasoning and review evidence; each step is an original educational exercise.

steps.title: 區分靜力與疲勞證據
steps.objective: 避免一次承載取代壽命主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid substituting one load test for lifetime evidence.
steps.instruction: 畫單次載荷與重複載荷兩種時間圖；為兩圖寫不同問題；列出需記錄的破壞與損傷指標。
steps.instructionEn: Draw single-load and repeated-load histories; write a different question for each; list damage and failure indicators to record.
steps.observation: 可承受一次負載不代表可承受所有循環。
steps.observationEn: Surviving one load does not establish cyclic capability.
steps.failure: 宣稱複材完全不會疲勞或損傷不正確。
steps.failureEn: Claiming composites cannot fatigue or damage is incorrect.
steps.check: 用一句話各界定強度與耐久性。
steps.checkEn: Define strength and durability separately.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 複材可能出現基材裂紋、分層等損傷，機制與金屬裂紋並不完全相同。
knowledge.textEn: Composites may develop matrix cracks and delamination; their mechanisms differ from metal cracking.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 試驗結論依載荷譜、環境與試件配置而定；改變其中一項後，原有壽命結論須重新檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Test conclusions depend on load spectrum, environment and specimen configuration; changing any of them requires reviewing lifetime conclusions.

quiz.question: 針對「區分靜力與疲勞證據」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Distinguish static and fatigue evidence’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 靜力通過不能取代疲勞評估
碳纖維結構絕不會累積損傷
一次高載荷代表全部壽命
optionsEn: Static success cannot replace fatigue evaluation
Carbon structures never accumulate damage
One high load proves full lifetime
quiz.explanation: 複材可能出現基材裂紋、分層等損傷，機制與金屬裂紋並不完全相同。 試驗結論依載荷譜、環境與試件配置而定；改變其中一項後，原有壽命結論須重新檢查。
quiz.explanationEn: Composites may develop matrix cracks and delamination; their mechanisms differ from metal cracking. Test conclusions depend on load spectrum, environment and specimen configuration; changing any of them requires reviewing lifetime conclusions.

steps.title: 分析壓力循環與局部開口
steps.objective: 看見孔口附近的受力轉移。
steps.objectiveEn: Recognize force transfer around openings.
steps.instruction: 畫完整圓筒與有窗孔圓筒；在孔周追蹤膜力；標出加強區並比較循環壓差的問題。
steps.instructionEn: Draw intact and windowed cylinders; trace membrane forces around the opening; mark reinforcement and compare cyclic-pressure concerns.
steps.observation: 開口迫使載荷繞行。
steps.observationEn: Openings redirect loads.
steps.failure: 只用完整薄殼公式評估孔邊會漏掉局部效應。
steps.failureEn: An intact-shell formula misses opening-edge effects.
steps.check: 提交局部載荷繞行圖及限制註記。
steps.checkEn: Submit a local load-bypass sketch with limitations.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 薄殼公式可作遠離不連續處的初步估算，但接頭、孔口與局部屈曲需更細模型。
knowledge.textEn: Thin-shell formulas give preliminary estimates away from discontinuities; joints, cutouts and buckling need finer models.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 壓力循環、濕熱與缺陷可能耦合；示意模型不能給飛行壽命。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure cycles, moisture, temperature and defects can interact; a sketch cannot establish flight life.

quiz.question: 針對「分析壓力循環與局部開口」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Analyze pressure cycles and cutouts’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 只有外形最漂亮的窗才安全
需要補充孔邊的局部分析
孔洞不會改變應力
optionsEn: Window appearance determines safety
Add local analysis around openings
Openings cannot alter stress
quiz.explanation: 薄殼公式可作遠離不連續處的初步估算，但接頭、孔口與局部屈曲需更細模型。 壓力循環、濕熱與缺陷可能耦合；示意模型不能給飛行壽命。
quiz.explanationEn: Thin-shell formulas give preliminary estimates away from discontinuities; joints, cutouts and buckling need finer models. Pressure cycles, moisture, temperature and defects can interact; a sketch cannot establish flight life.

steps.title: 解釋氣動彈性耦合
steps.objective: 區分剛體氣動與柔性回饋。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish rigid aerodynamics from flexible feedback.
steps.instruction: 畫氣流、機翼變形與載荷三節點；連成回饋環；改變假想剛度，說明需要哪些試驗而不推算真機邊界。
steps.instructionEn: Draw airflow, wing deformation and load nodes; connect a feedback loop; change assumed stiffness and identify required tests without predicting aircraft limits.
steps.observation: 變形可以反過來改變氣動載荷。
steps.observationEn: Deformation can change aerodynamic loading.
steps.failure: 只看靜態撓度不能確定動態穩定。
steps.failureEn: Static deflection alone cannot establish dynamic stability.
steps.check: 指出回饋鏈中至少兩個不確定因素。
steps.checkEn: Identify at least two uncertainties in the feedback chain.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 氣動彈性涉及結構、慣性與氣動的耦合，穩定性需條件完整的分析與驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Aeroelasticity couples structure, inertia and aerodynamics; stability needs fully specified analysis and validation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 縮尺試驗涉及相似律，不能僅按長度比例複製。
knowledge.textEn: Scale tests require similarity considerations, not just geometric scaling.

quiz.question: 針對「解釋氣動彈性耦合」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Explain aeroelastic coupling’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 靜止時不晃動就永不顫振
縮小尺寸即可保持所有動態特性
柔性與氣動必須一起評估
optionsEn: No motion at rest proves no flutter
Shrinking dimensions preserves all dynamics
Evaluate flexibility and aerodynamics together
quiz.explanation: 氣動彈性涉及結構、慣性與氣動的耦合，穩定性需條件完整的分析與驗證。 縮尺試驗涉及相似律，不能僅按長度比例複製。
quiz.explanationEn: Aeroelasticity couples structure, inertia and aerodynamics; stability needs fully specified analysis and validation. Scale tests require similarity considerations, not just geometric scaling.

steps.title: 設計軟體與硬體整合案例
steps.objective: 測到正常與異常介面行為。
steps.objectiveEn: Exercise nominal and abnormal interface behavior.
steps.instruction: 寫三個模擬案例：正常、延遲、錯誤單位；指定預期輸出；比較實際記錄與預期並保存配置。
steps.instructionEn: Write nominal, delayed and wrong-unit simulation cases; specify expected outputs; compare results against expectations and record configuration.
steps.observation: 可重現故障比偶然成功更能定位問題。
steps.observationEn: Reproducible faults localize issues better than accidental success.
steps.failure: 只有正常案例無法覆蓋例外行為。
steps.failureEn: Nominal cases alone do not cover exceptions.
steps.check: 每個案例含輸入、預期、實際與版本。
steps.checkEn: Include input, expected result, actual result and version in each case.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 整合試驗驗證介面假設；單元測試通過不表示完整系統必然正常。
knowledge.textEn: Integration tests check interface assumptions; passing unit tests does not guarantee system success.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 模擬覆蓋率不等於真機驗證完備，模型本身也需確認。
knowledge.textEn: Simulation coverage does not equal complete aircraft verification; models require validation too.

quiz.question: 針對「設計軟體與硬體整合案例」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Design software–hardware integration cases’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 故障注入應有明確預期結果
只跑一次正常輸入即可
模型通過即可免除其他驗證
optionsEn: Fault injection needs explicit expected results
One nominal input is sufficient
Model success eliminates all other verification
quiz.explanation: 整合試驗驗證介面假設；單元測試通過不表示完整系統必然正常。 模擬覆蓋率不等於真機驗證完備，模型本身也需確認。
quiz.explanationEn: Integration tests check interface assumptions; passing unit tests does not guarantee system success. Simulation coverage does not equal complete aircraft verification; models require validation too.

steps.title: 整理不合格與設計變更鏈
steps.objective: 避免修改破壞既有驗證。
steps.objectiveEn: Prevent changes from invalidating prior evidence.
steps.instruction: 假設一個接頭材料改版；列受影響的圖、分析與試驗；標出要重驗、可沿用及待證明的項目。
steps.instructionEn: Assume a joint material revision; list affected drawings, analyses and tests; mark retest, reusable and unresolved evidence.
steps.observation: 小改動也可能跨越材料與電性介面。
steps.observationEn: A small change can cross material and electrical interfaces.
steps.failure: 只改圖號不檢查證據適用性不完整。
steps.failureEn: Changing a drawing number without reviewing evidence is incomplete.
steps.check: 用影響矩陣連接改動與全部相關主張。
steps.checkEn: Link the change to relevant claims in an impact matrix.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 配置控制讓證據對應到真正受驗的物件，而不是抽象的產品名稱。
knowledge.textEn: Configuration control ties evidence to the item actually tested, not an abstract product name.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 重用證據需說明等效性；無理由的沿用是未決風險。
knowledge.textEn: Reusing evidence requires an equivalence argument; unexplained reuse remains unresolved.

quiz.question: 針對「整理不合格與設計變更鏈」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Organize nonconformance and design changes’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 材料改變不會影響電氣介面
變更後重新判斷證據適用性
只要產品名稱相同即可沿用
optionsEn: Material changes never affect electrical interfaces
Reassess evidence applicability after change
A shared product name justifies all reuse
quiz.explanation: 配置控制讓證據對應到真正受驗的物件，而不是抽象的產品名稱。 重用證據需說明等效性；無理由的沿用是未決風險。
quiz.explanationEn: Configuration control ties evidence to the item actually tested, not an abstract product name. Reusing evidence requires an equivalence argument; unexplained reuse remains unresolved.

steps.title: 完成總工程師交付審查
steps.objective: 以可追溯證據說明能與不能主張的事。
steps.objectiveEn: State what evidence does and does not support.
steps.instruction: 彙整材料、結構、電力三份圖；把每個結論連至檢核紀錄；列三個尚需專業驗證的問題並比較 A350 相近課程。
steps.instructionEn: Collect material, structure and power diagrams; link conclusions to review records; list three questions needing professional verification and compare the related A350 course.
steps.observation: 總裝完成與適航放行是不同里程碑。
steps.observationEn: Assembly completion and airworthiness release are different milestones.
steps.failure: 把完成學習勾選當真實製造資格會誤解。
steps.failureEn: Course completion is not manufacturing qualification.
steps.check: 審查表中包含證據、限制、未決事項與相似工法。
steps.checkEn: Include evidence, limits, open issues and related methods.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 大型客機共同面對複材、系統介面及試驗追溯；各型號實作不能直接互換。
knowledge.textEn: Large airliners share composite, interface and test-traceability problems; implementations are not interchangeable.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 交付審查可用主張—證據—未決事項矩陣，避免把缺資料誤寫為零風險，並保留責任與版本。
knowledge.textEn: Delivery review can use a claim–evidence–open-item matrix to avoid mistaking missing information for zero risk and to preserve responsibility and version.

quiz.question: 針對「完成總工程師交付審查」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Complete the chief-engineer review’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 所有相似飛機可共用維修方法
完成課程即可核准真機放行
結論應與配置及證據一起呈現
optionsEn: Similar aircraft share all maintenance methods
Course completion authorizes aircraft release
Present conclusions with configuration and evidence
quiz.explanation: 大型客機共同面對複材、系統介面及試驗追溯；各型號實作不能直接互換。 交付審查可用主張—證據—未決事項矩陣，避免把缺資料誤寫為零風險，並保留責任與版本。
quiz.explanationEn: Large airliners share composite, interface and test-traceability problems; implementations are not interchangeable. Delivery review can use a claim–evidence–open-item matrix to avoid mistaking missing information for zero risk and to preserve responsibility and version.

courses.title: James Webb 太空望遠鏡
courses.summary: 以二十四步拆解紅外觀測、分段鏡對準、遮陽隔熱、展開與地面驗證。
courses.summaryEn: Twenty-four steps examine infrared observation, mirror phasing, shielding, deployment and ground verification.
courses.scope: 所有圖解與數值為公開原理的教學模型；不是 NASA 操作程序、飛行軟體或可製造的望遠鏡圖。地圖指向 Goddard 地面機構，Webb 本體位於日地 L2 附近軌道。
courses.scopeEn: Diagrams and numbers are teaching models of public principles, not NASA procedures, flight software or buildable telescope drawings. The map marks Goddard on Earth; Webb itself orbits near Sun–Earth L2.

stages.title: 觀測需求與系統分界
stages.description: 由光子、熱與幾何理解太空望遠鏡。
stages.descriptionEn: Understand the telescope through photons, heat and geometry.
stages.route: 先完成前置學習，再提交圖解、推理與檢核證據；每一步均為原創教育任務。
stages.routeEn: Complete the prerequisites, then submit diagrams, reasoning and review evidence; each step is an original educational exercise.

steps.title: 把科學問題轉成觀測量
steps.objective: 區分亮度、位置與光譜問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish brightness, position and spectral questions.
steps.instruction: 選星系與系外行星兩種假想問題；寫出要量的物理量；為每個量指定成像或光譜並標記未知條件。
steps.instructionEn: Choose hypothetical galaxy and exoplanet questions; write the measured quantities; assign imaging or spectroscopy and mark unknown conditions.
steps.observation: 不同科學問題需要不同資料產品。
steps.observationEn: Different science questions need different data products.
steps.failure: 把所有觀測都稱為拍照會遺漏光譜。
steps.failureEn: Calling every observation a photograph omits spectroscopy.
steps.check: 交出問題、觀測量、儀器功能三欄表。
steps.checkEn: Submit question, observable and instrument-function columns.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 成像保留空間分布；光譜把光分到波長座標以分析訊號。
knowledge.textEn: Imaging preserves spatial distribution; spectroscopy separates light by wavelength for analysis.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 科學結論需要校準與模型，不能由單一美化影像直接推出。
knowledge.textEn: Scientific conclusions need calibration and models, not a single presentation image.

quiz.question: 針對「把科學問題轉成觀測量」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Translate science questions into observables’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 先決定觀測量再選資料形式
所有問題只需要彩色圖片
亮點的顏色可直接等同物質成分
optionsEn: Define observables before selecting data form
Every question needs only a color picture
A bright spot’s displayed color directly identifies composition
quiz.explanation: 成像保留空間分布；光譜把光分到波長座標以分析訊號。 科學結論需要校準與模型，不能由單一美化影像直接推出。
quiz.explanationEn: Imaging preserves spatial distribution; spectroscopy separates light by wavelength for analysis. Scientific conclusions need calibration and models, not a single presentation image.

steps.title: 辨識紅外波段與熱背景
steps.titleEn: Identify infrared bands and thermal background
steps.objective: 理解儀器自身也會產生背景。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand that the instrument also contributes background.
steps.instruction: 畫目標光與望遠鏡熱輻射兩條路；用相同單位標示概念訊號；比較冷卻前後的背景比例。
steps.instructionEn: Draw target-light and telescope-emission paths; label conceptual signals in matching units; compare background fractions before and after cooling.
steps.observation: 降低背景可改善微弱訊號的辨識。
steps.observationEn: Lower background can improve detection of faint signals.
steps.failure: 把冷卻等同增加目標亮度不正確。
steps.failureEn: Cooling does not brighten the target itself.
steps.check: 分別說明訊號來源與背景來源。
steps.checkEn: Explain signal and background origins separately.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 紅外偵測中，儀器熱輻射可能與天體訊號競爭。
knowledge.textEn: Instrumental thermal emission may compete with astronomical infrared signals.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 冷卻效果受波段、探測器與熱路徑影響，不能只用一個溫度概括。
knowledge.textEn: Cooling effects depend on band, detector and thermal paths, not one temperature alone.

quiz.question: 針對「辨識紅外波段與熱背景」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Identify infrared bands and thermal background’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 所有波長有相同熱背景
冷卻主要改變儀器背景
冷卻會讓遠方天體本身更亮
optionsEn: Every wavelength has identical thermal background
Cooling mainly changes instrumental background
Cooling makes distant objects intrinsically brighter
quiz.explanation: 紅外偵測中，儀器熱輻射可能與天體訊號競爭。 冷卻效果受波段、探測器與熱路徑影響，不能只用一個溫度概括。
quiz.explanationEn: Instrumental thermal emission may compete with astronomical infrared signals. Cooling effects depend on band, detector and thermal paths, not one temperature alone.

steps.title: 分開 L2 軌道與地面座標
steps.titleEn: Separate L2 orbit from ground coordinates
steps.objective: 避免用地圖標記誤解太空位置。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid mistaking a map marker for a space position.
steps.instruction: 畫太陽、地球與 L2 概念圖；另開 Goddard 的地圖卡；為兩圖標不同座標系與物件名稱。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch Sun, Earth and L2; open the separate Goddard map card; label different frames and objects on the two diagrams.
steps.observation: 地理地址表示機構，不表示太空載具位置。
steps.observationEn: A street address locates an institution, not the spacecraft.
steps.failure: 將地圖經緯度寫成 Webb 本體座標會誤導。
steps.failureEn: Calling map latitude/longitude the Webb position is misleading.
steps.check: 能清楚解釋地面點與軌道示意的差別。
steps.checkEn: Explain the difference between a ground marker and an orbit schematic.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: L2 附近的軌道不是停在一個固定點；日地幾何與控制共同影響任務條件。
knowledge.textEn: An orbit near L2 is not a stationary point; Sun–Earth geometry and control influence mission conditions.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 地球經緯度與太空星曆使用不同座標系；位置還需時間、原點與座標方向，單有一對數字無法定位。
knowledge.textEn: Terrestrial coordinates and space ephemerides use different frames; position also needs time, origin and axes, not just two numbers.

quiz.question: 針對「分開 L2 軌道與地面座標」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Separate L2 orbit from ground coordinates’, which conclusion is justified?
options: Webb 停在 Goddard 屋頂
L2 是地球上一個經緯度
Goddard 標記代表地面研發管理機構
optionsEn: Webb sits on Goddard’s roof
L2 is a terrestrial latitude/longitude
The Goddard marker represents a ground research and management institution
quiz.explanation: L2 附近的軌道不是停在一個固定點；日地幾何與控制共同影響任務條件。 地球經緯度與太空星曆使用不同座標系；位置還需時間、原點與座標方向，單有一對數字無法定位。
quiz.explanationEn: An orbit near L2 is not a stationary point; Sun–Earth geometry and control influence mission conditions. Terrestrial coordinates and space ephemerides use different frames; position also needs time, origin and axes, not just two numbers.

steps.title: 分配收光面積與解析能力
steps.objective: 辨識口徑影響的不同指標。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish the different effects of aperture.
steps.instruction: 畫兩種假想口徑；用面積比較收光；再討論波長改變時繞射尺度如何變化。
steps.instructionEn: Draw two hypothetical apertures; compare area for light collection; discuss how diffraction scale changes with wavelength.
steps.observation: 收光量與角解析力相互關聯但不是同一數值。
steps.observationEn: Light collection and angular resolution are related but distinct.
steps.failure: 只用像素數代表光學解析力不成立。
steps.failureEn: Pixel count alone does not determine optical resolution.
steps.check: 表格分列面積、波長、像素與角尺度。
steps.checkEn: List area, wavelength, pixels and angular scale separately.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 理想繞射尺度與波長成正比、口徑成反比；真實像質還受像差與取樣影響。
knowledge.textEn: Ideal diffraction scale grows with wavelength and decreases with aperture; real quality also depends on aberrations and sampling.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 增加收光面積改善光子數，卻不能修正失焦或姿態抖動。
knowledge.textEn: More collecting area improves photon counts but does not correct defocus or pointing jitter.

quiz.question: 針對「分配收光面積與解析能力」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Separate collecting area from resolution’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 像質需同時看口徑、波長與取樣
增加像素即可無限提高解析度
收光面積就是角解析力的單位
optionsEn: Assess aperture, wavelength and sampling together
More pixels provide unlimited resolution
Collecting area is a unit of angular resolution
quiz.explanation: 理想繞射尺度與波長成正比、口徑成反比；真實像質還受像差與取樣影響。 增加收光面積改善光子數，卻不能修正失焦或姿態抖動。
quiz.explanationEn: Ideal diffraction scale grows with wavelength and decreases with aperture; real quality also depends on aberrations and sampling. More collecting area improves photon counts but does not correct defocus or pointing jitter.

steps.title: 繪製熱端與冷端介面
steps.objective: 找到跨越隔熱邊界的路徑。
steps.objectiveEn: Locate paths crossing thermal boundaries.
steps.instruction: 將電源、通訊、鏡面與儀器分類；畫穿越遮陽板邊界的線；標記結構、電線與輻射三種熱路徑。
steps.instructionEn: Classify power, communications, mirrors and instruments; draw boundary-crossing links; mark structural, wiring and radiation heat paths.
steps.observation: 遮住陽光不會消除所有熱傳。
steps.observationEn: Blocking sunlight does not remove every heat-transfer path.
steps.failure: 忽略電纜導熱會漏掉跨界熱負載。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring cable conduction omits cross-boundary heat load.
steps.check: 每條跨界線都有功能與熱影響註記。
steps.checkEn: Annotate function and thermal effect on each crossing.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 真空中沒有一般空氣對流，但仍有固體導熱與輻射。
knowledge.textEn: Vacuum removes ordinary air convection but not conduction or radiation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 功能與隔熱要求可能衝突，需跨系統預算而不是單一零件最優化。
knowledge.textEn: Functional and isolation requirements may conflict, requiring a system budget rather than one-part optimization.

quiz.question: 針對「繪製熱端與冷端介面」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Draw hot-side and cold-side interfaces’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 遮陽板可隔絕所有電線導熱
需同時檢查導熱與輻射
真空中完全沒有熱傳
optionsEn: A sunshield blocks all cable conduction
Check conduction and radiation
Vacuum prevents all heat transfer
quiz.explanation: 真空中沒有一般空氣對流，但仍有固體導熱與輻射。 功能與隔熱要求可能衝突，需跨系統預算而不是單一零件最優化。
quiz.explanationEn: Vacuum removes ordinary air convection but not conduction or radiation. Functional and isolation requirements may conflict, requiring a system budget rather than one-part optimization.

steps.title: 建立收納與展開依賴圖
steps.titleEn: Build a stowage and deployment dependency graph
steps.objective: 用先後條件理解複雜機構。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand complex mechanisms through prerequisites.
steps.instruction: 畫收納外形與展開外形；列出三種假想先決條件；畫無循環依賴圖並標出不可逆動作。
steps.instructionEn: Draw stowed and deployed envelopes; list three hypothetical prerequisites; create an acyclic dependency graph and mark irreversible actions.
steps.observation: 最後形狀可行不保證展開路徑可行。
steps.observationEn: A feasible final shape does not prove a feasible deployment path.
steps.failure: 用動畫外觀取代接觸與相依分析會漏判。
steps.failureEn: Appearance-only animation misses contacts and dependencies.
steps.check: 每個動作有前置狀態與完成證據。
steps.checkEn: Each action needs a prior state and completion evidence.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 展開工程同時處理包絡、機構自由度與狀態確認。
knowledge.textEn: Deployment engineering addresses envelopes, mechanism degrees of freedom and state confirmation.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 若依賴圖出現循環，必須重新定義可達狀態；前置動作完成應有獨立狀態證據。
knowledge.textEn: Cycles in a dependency graph require redefining reachable states; prerequisite completion needs independent state evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「建立收納與展開依賴圖」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Build a stowage and deployment dependency graph’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 只要終點正確就能任意展開
動作可全部同時執行
檢查整段路徑與先決條件
optionsEn: Any deployment path works if the final shape is right
Every action can occur simultaneously
Check the entire path and prerequisites
quiz.explanation: 展開工程同時處理包絡、機構自由度與狀態確認。 若依賴圖出現循環，必須重新定義可達狀態；前置動作完成應有獨立狀態證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Deployment engineering addresses envelopes, mechanism degrees of freedom and state confirmation. Cycles in a dependency graph require redefining reachable states; prerequisite completion needs independent state evidence.

stages.title: 分段光學與波前
stages.description: 分清成像位置、相位與視場一致性。
stages.descriptionEn: Separate image position, phase and field consistency.
stages.route: 先完成前置學習，再提交圖解、推理與檢核證據；每一步均為原創教育任務。
stages.routeEn: Complete the prerequisites, then submit diagrams, reasoning and review evidence; each step is an original educational exercise.

steps.title: 理解分段鏡面的鋪排
steps.objective: 把機械分段與光學整體分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate mechanical segments from optical unity.
steps.instruction: 畫六角鏡片與間隙；標每片獨立身分；追蹤同一星光如何由多片鏡面貢獻。
steps.instructionEn: Draw hexagonal segments and gaps; identify each segment; trace how many segments contribute to one star image.
steps.observation: 分段數不等於獨立望遠鏡數。
steps.observationEn: Segment count is not the number of separate telescopes.
steps.failure: 把接縫抹掉並不代表光學已對準。
steps.failureEn: Removing drawn seams does not establish optical phasing.
steps.check: 同時保留零件身分與共同波前概念。
steps.checkEn: Preserve part identity and the shared-wavefront concept.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: Webb 主鏡由十八片鏡段構成；能否形成共同波前取決於相對對準。
knowledge.textEn: Webb’s primary has eighteen segments; a common wavefront depends on relative alignment.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 分段形式解決尺寸與展開問題，也增加控制與驗證介面。
knowledge.textEn: Segmentation addresses packaging and deployment while adding control and verification interfaces.

quiz.question: 針對「理解分段鏡面的鋪排」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Understand segmented-mirror tiling’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 多片鏡面需要共同的光學對準
每片只拍自己的天空區塊
接縫不見即代表相位一致
optionsEn: Multiple segments need common optical alignment
Each segment photographs its own sky region
Invisible seams prove matched phase
quiz.explanation: Webb 主鏡由十八片鏡段構成；能否形成共同波前取決於相對對準。 分段形式解決尺寸與展開問題，也增加控制與驗證介面。
quiz.explanationEn: Webb’s primary has eighteen segments; a common wavefront depends on relative alignment. Segmentation addresses packaging and deployment while adding control and verification interfaces.

steps.title: 區分活塞與傾斜誤差
steps.objective: 辨認不同自由度造成的像差。
steps.objectiveEn: Recognize errors from different degrees of freedom.
steps.instruction: 畫兩片教學鏡面；一片只前後移、一片只旋轉；比較路徑長與光線方向並作註記。
steps.instructionEn: Draw two teaching mirror segments; translate one and rotate the other; compare path length and ray direction.
steps.observation: 位置與傾角錯誤需要不同解釋。
steps.observationEn: Position and tilt errors require different interpretations.
steps.failure: 只看光點中心無法涵蓋所有波前誤差。
steps.failureEn: Image-center position does not capture every wavefront error.
steps.check: 圖中分別標出平移與旋轉。
steps.checkEn: Label translation and rotation separately.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 活塞改變相對光程，傾斜改變光線方向；二者不能視為同一調整量。
knowledge.textEn: Piston changes relative optical path; tilt changes ray direction; they are not the same adjustment.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 真實調整受多自由度耦合與感測可觀測性限制。
knowledge.textEn: Real alignment is limited by coupled degrees of freedom and observability.

quiz.question: 針對「區分活塞與傾斜誤差」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Distinguish piston and tilt errors’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 平移與旋轉是同一自由度
需分辨位置與角度誤差
光點重疊即保證所有波前都一致
optionsEn: Translation and rotation are identical
Distinguish positional and angular errors
Overlapping spots guarantee perfect wavefronts
quiz.explanation: 活塞改變相對光程，傾斜改變光線方向；二者不能視為同一調整量。 真實調整受多自由度耦合與感測可觀測性限制。
quiz.explanationEn: Piston changes relative optical path; tilt changes ray direction; they are not the same adjustment. Real alignment is limited by coupled degrees of freedom and observability.

steps.title: 比較像點重疊與相位一致
steps.titleEn: Compare image stacking and phase agreement
steps.objective: 了解幾何對準之後仍有光程問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand remaining optical-path issues after geometric alignment.
steps.instruction: 將虛構星點移到同一中心；畫兩條不同相位的波形；列出中心重疊仍無法證明的事項。
steps.instructionEn: Move simulated star spots to one center; draw two waveforms with different phases; list what common centering does not establish.
steps.observation: 同位置強度圖仍可能隱藏相位差。
steps.observationEn: Co-located intensity patterns may hide phase differences.
steps.failure: 只用紅箭頭中心作相位驗證會誤導。
steps.failureEn: A centered guidance arrow is not a phase measurement.
steps.check: 說明位置、相位與波前三者關係。
steps.checkEn: Explain image position, phase and wavefront relationships.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 光學相干疊加涉及相位；簡單幾何光線圖無法表達全部繞射行為。
knowledge.textEn: Coherent optical addition depends on phase; ray sketches cannot describe all diffraction effects.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 相位量測可能有週期性歧義；不同尺度的誤差估計能幫助區分大偏差與精細對準。
knowledge.textEn: Phase measurements can have periodic ambiguity; different error scales help distinguish large offsets from fine alignment.

quiz.question: 針對「比較像點重疊與相位一致」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Compare image stacking and phase agreement’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 中心重疊就是全部對準完成
相位差等於鏡片顏色差
中心重疊之後仍需波前證據
optionsEn: Center overlap completes all alignment
Phase difference is a color difference
Wavefront evidence is still needed after image stacking
quiz.explanation: 光學相干疊加涉及相位；簡單幾何光線圖無法表達全部繞射行為。 相位量測可能有週期性歧義；不同尺度的誤差估計能幫助區分大偏差與精細對準。
quiz.explanationEn: Coherent optical addition depends on phase; ray sketches cannot describe all diffraction effects. Phase measurements can have periodic ambiguity; different error scales help distinguish large offsets from fine alignment.

steps.title: 建立量測—修正回饋迴路
steps.objective: 把誤差估計與機構調整分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate error estimation from actuator adjustment.
steps.instruction: 畫影像、估計、命令與再量測四節點；加入一個假想偏差；以小幅修正示例檢查誤差是否下降。
steps.instructionEn: Draw image, estimate, command and remeasurement nodes; introduce an assumed bias; use a small correction example and inspect error reduction.
steps.observation: 修正後必須再次觀察。
steps.observationEn: A correction needs remeasurement.
steps.failure: 把估計值當絕對真值可能造成過度修正。
steps.failureEn: Treating estimates as truth can overcorrect.
steps.check: 記錄每輪前後誤差與不確定度。
steps.checkEn: Record before/after error and uncertainty each cycle.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 閉迴路依賴可量測的誤差與適當增益，控制命令並不等於結果。
knowledge.textEn: Closed loops need observable errors and suitable gain; commands are not outcomes.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 高增益可能放大量測雜訊或引發振盪；控制效果須用收斂速度、殘差與穩定度共同比較。
knowledge.textEn: High gain can amplify noise or induce oscillation; compare convergence, residual error and stability together.

quiz.question: 針對「建立量測—修正回饋迴路」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Build a measurement–correction loop’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 調整後重新量測才知道效果
發出命令即證明誤差歸零
增益越大一定越穩定
optionsEn: Remeasure after adjustment to establish effect
Sending a command proves zero error
Higher gain always improves stability
quiz.explanation: 閉迴路依賴可量測的誤差與適當增益，控制命令並不等於結果。 高增益可能放大量測雜訊或引發振盪；控制效果須用收斂速度、殘差與穩定度共同比較。
quiz.explanationEn: Closed loops need observable errors and suitable gain; commands are not outcomes. High gain can amplify noise or induce oscillation; compare convergence, residual error and stability together.

steps.title: 檢查視場與儀器的一致性
steps.objective: 避免只在一個位置最佳化。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid optimizing only one field point.
steps.instruction: 在教學視場標中心及四角；記錄假想像質指標；比較單點最佳與多點折衷方案。
steps.instructionEn: Mark a center and four field corners; record hypothetical quality metrics; compare single-point optimization with a multi-point compromise.
steps.observation: 中心像質好不等於全視場一致。
steps.observationEn: Good central quality does not establish field-wide consistency.
steps.failure: 將一個儀器結果套到所有儀器不成立。
steps.failureEn: One instrument’s result cannot cover all instruments.
steps.check: 報表包含視場位置及測試模式。
steps.checkEn: Include field position and test mode in the report.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 光學系統的像差可能隨視場變化，多儀器介面增加一致性要求。
knowledge.textEn: Aberrations may vary across a field; multiple instruments add consistency requirements.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 比較需固定波段、焦點條件與定義，否則指標不一定可比。
knowledge.textEn: Comparisons need fixed band, focus conditions and definitions.

quiz.question: 針對「檢查視場與儀器的一致性」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Review field and instrument consistency’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 不同波段的任何指標可直接相加
應跨視場與模式保留量測條件
中心測一次即可代表全場
optionsEn: Arbitrary metrics from different bands can be added
Preserve conditions across field points and modes
One center test represents the entire field
quiz.explanation: 光學系統的像差可能隨視場變化，多儀器介面增加一致性要求。 比較需固定波段、焦點條件與定義，否則指標不一定可比。
quiz.explanationEn: Aberrations may vary across a field; multiple instruments add consistency requirements. Comparisons need fixed band, focus conditions and definitions.

steps.title: 建立低溫光學誤差預算
steps.objective: 區分製造、對準與環境變化。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate manufacture, alignment and environmental change.
steps.instruction: 列出面形、定位與熱變形三種誤差；以相同波前單位表達；標示哪些可校正及哪些須重新驗證。
steps.instructionEn: List figure, alignment and thermal errors; express them in a common wavefront unit; identify correctable and re-verification items.
steps.observation: 單一漂亮面形無法保證全系統像質。
steps.observationEn: An excellent surface alone cannot guarantee system image quality.
steps.failure: 不同單位直接相加會產生假精準。
steps.failureEn: Adding incompatible units creates false precision.
steps.check: 每項誤差都有來源、單位與條件。
steps.checkEn: Each error has origin, units and conditions.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 誤差預算的合成方式依相關性而定，不是所有項目都可平方和開根號。
knowledge.textEn: Error-budget combination depends on correlation; root-sum-square is not universally valid.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 低溫材料行為與結構穩定度需要環境試驗支持。
knowledge.textEn: Cryogenic material behavior and structural stability need environmental-test support.

quiz.question: 針對「建立低溫光學誤差預算」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Build a cold-optics error budget’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 所有誤差必然互不相關
室溫檢查可完全取代低溫驗證
先統一量的定義再合成
optionsEn: All errors are automatically independent
Room-temperature inspection replaces cryogenic verification
Unify definitions before combining errors
quiz.explanation: 誤差預算的合成方式依相關性而定，不是所有項目都可平方和開根號。 低溫材料行為與結構穩定度需要環境試驗支持。
quiz.explanationEn: Error-budget combination depends on correlation; root-sum-square is not universally valid. Cryogenic material behavior and structural stability need environmental-test support.

stages.title: 遮陽、展開與穩定度
stages.description: 把熱路徑與機構相依關係視為共同問題。
stages.descriptionEn: Treat thermal paths and mechanism dependencies together.
stages.route: 先完成前置學習，再提交圖解、推理與檢核證據；每一步均為原創教育任務。
stages.routeEn: Complete the prerequisites, then submit diagrams, reasoning and review evidence; each step is an original educational exercise.

steps.title: 繪製五層遮陽板的熱流
steps.titleEn: Draw heat flow through five shield layers
steps.objective: 理解分層與間距的功能。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand layering and separation.
steps.instruction: 畫五片不相碰的薄膜；標入射與向外散熱箭頭；比較層間保持分離與局部接觸的差異。
steps.instructionEn: Draw five separated membranes; mark incoming and outgoing radiation; compare separated layers with local contact.
steps.observation: 薄膜分層不只是增加材料厚度。
steps.observationEn: Multiple membranes do more than increase material thickness.
steps.failure: 把五層壓成一片會改變熱路徑。
steps.failureEn: Pressing layers together changes heat paths.
steps.check: 說明層間間距為何影響隔熱。
steps.checkEn: Explain why layer separation matters thermally.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 多層設計利用輻射交換與幾何把熱導向太空，接觸則可能增加導熱。
knowledge.textEn: Multiple layers use radiative exchange and geometry to reject heat; contact may increase conduction.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 各層互相看見的面積與角度決定輻射交換比例；遮陽效果因此和形狀及相對位置相連。
knowledge.textEn: Relative visible areas and angles determine radiative exchange; shielding therefore depends on shape and placement.

quiz.question: 針對「繪製五層遮陽板的熱流」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Draw heat flow through five shield layers’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 層間幾何是熱設計的一部分
五層只為了讓顏色漂亮
接觸與分離的熱效果完全相同
optionsEn: Interlayer geometry is part of thermal design
Five layers are purely decorative
Contact and separation are thermally identical
quiz.explanation: 多層設計利用輻射交換與幾何把熱導向太空，接觸則可能增加導熱。 各層互相看見的面積與角度決定輻射交換比例；遮陽效果因此和形狀及相對位置相連。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiple layers use radiative exchange and geometry to reject heat; contact may increase conduction. Relative visible areas and angles determine radiative exchange; shielding therefore depends on shape and placement.

steps.title: 分開反射率與放射率
steps.objective: 避免用可見顏色推論全部熱性能。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid inferring all thermal properties from visible color.
steps.instruction: 畫太陽波段與紅外波段兩欄；分別註記吸收與放射；比較兩種假想塗層並列出需要測量的光譜資料。
steps.instructionEn: Draw solar and infrared columns; note absorption and emission separately; compare hypothetical coatings and list required spectral measurements.
steps.observation: 不同波段的表面行為可能不同。
steps.observationEn: Surface behavior may differ by spectral band.
steps.failure: 看起來亮就等於所有波段都低吸收不正確。
steps.failureEn: A shiny appearance does not prove low absorption in every band.
steps.check: 評估表保留波長範圍與溫度條件。
steps.checkEn: Keep wavelength range and temperature conditions in the table.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 光譜選擇性使太陽吸收與熱放射不能只用肉眼顏色判定。
knowledge.textEn: Spectral selectivity prevents visual color from determining solar absorption and thermal emission.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 熱平衡還受視角、面積與周遭輻射環境影響。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal balance also depends on view geometry, area and surrounding radiation.

quiz.question: 針對「分開反射率與放射率」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Separate reflectance from emittance’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 只看可見光照片即可選航天塗層
需要光譜與環境條件
所有銀色物體熱性能相同
optionsEn: A visible photograph is enough to select spacecraft coatings
Spectral and environmental conditions are needed
All silver-colored objects have identical thermal behavior
quiz.explanation: 光譜選擇性使太陽吸收與熱放射不能只用肉眼顏色判定。 熱平衡還受視角、面積與周遭輻射環境影響。
quiz.explanationEn: Spectral selectivity prevents visual color from determining solar absorption and thermal emission. Thermal balance also depends on view geometry, area and surrounding radiation.

steps.title: 審查薄膜張力與邊界條件
steps.objective: 把形狀維持與熱功能連起來。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect shape retention to thermal function.
steps.instruction: 用紙面示意膜邊固定點；加入一個鬆弛區；比較局部皺摺如何改變間距與視角。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch membrane boundary attachments; add a slack region; compare how wrinkles change spacing and view geometry.
steps.observation: 機械形狀改變也可能影響熱路徑。
steps.observationEn: Mechanical shape changes may alter thermal paths.
steps.failure: 只確認固定點存在不足以證明整面形狀。
steps.failureEn: Attachment existence does not establish membrane shape.
steps.check: 標出固定、可動與未知邊界。
steps.checkEn: Mark fixed, movable and unknown boundaries.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 薄膜主要透過面內張力維持形狀，其行為與抗彎板不同。
knowledge.textEn: Membranes retain shape mainly through in-plane tension and differ from bending plates.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 邊界固定方式改變張力分布；皺摺會同時改變局部應力和層間幾何，因此不能分開最佳化。
knowledge.textEn: Boundary restraints change tension distribution; wrinkles affect local stress and interlayer geometry and cannot be optimized independently.

quiz.question: 針對「審查薄膜張力與邊界條件」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Review membrane tension and boundaries’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 薄膜與厚鋼板的力學完全相同
增加張力永遠沒有副作用
應把形狀與熱效果一起審查
optionsEn: Membranes behave exactly like thick steel plates
Increasing tension never has trade-offs
Review shape and thermal effects together
quiz.explanation: 薄膜主要透過面內張力維持形狀，其行為與抗彎板不同。 邊界固定方式改變張力分布；皺摺會同時改變局部應力和層間幾何，因此不能分開最佳化。
quiz.explanationEn: Membranes retain shape mainly through in-plane tension and differ from bending plates. Boundary restraints change tension distribution; wrinkles affect local stress and interlayer geometry and cannot be optimized independently.

steps.title: 建立展開完成的證據表
steps.objective: 分辨發令、移動與鎖定。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish command, movement and latch.
steps.instruction: 為假想鉸鏈定義三種狀態；列位置與狀態兩類證據；模擬命令已送但未確認到位的情況。
steps.instructionEn: Define three states for a hypothetical hinge; list position and state evidence; simulate a sent command without confirmed arrival.
steps.observation: 命令成功送出不等於機構完成。
steps.observationEn: A sent command does not prove mechanism completion.
steps.failure: 沒有獨立確認就前進可能掩蓋未決狀態。
steps.failureEn: Advancing without independent confirmation hides uncertainty.
steps.check: 狀態表包含未知而非強迫二選一。
steps.checkEn: Include unknown states rather than forced binary choices.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 複雜機構的狀態估計依多個觀察來源，證據相依性需透明。
knowledge.textEn: Complex mechanism states use multiple observations whose dependencies must be explicit.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 互相獨立的觀察能降低共因誤判；若兩個指示都依同一感測器，數量增加並未增加獨立證據。
knowledge.textEn: Independent observations reduce common-cause misinterpretation; two indicators using one sensor do not provide independent evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「建立展開完成的證據表」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Build deployment-completion evidence’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 未確認到位應保留未知狀態
命令送出就一定完成
未知必須直接改成正常
optionsEn: Preserve an unknown state when arrival is unconfirmed
Sending a command guarantees completion
Unknown must be relabeled normal
quiz.explanation: 複雜機構的狀態估計依多個觀察來源，證據相依性需透明。 互相獨立的觀察能降低共因誤判；若兩個指示都依同一感測器，數量增加並未增加獨立證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Complex mechanism states use multiple observations whose dependencies must be explicit. Independent observations reduce common-cause misinterpretation; two indicators using one sensor do not provide independent evidence.

steps.title: 評估熱漂移對鏡面影響
steps.titleEn: Assess thermal drift effects on mirrors
steps.objective: 連結緩慢熱變化與光學誤差。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect slow thermal changes to optical error.
steps.instruction: 畫溫度與像質兩條假想時間序列；標示時間延遲；提出相關與因果需要的額外證據。
steps.instructionEn: Draw hypothetical temperature and image-quality timelines; mark delay; identify extra evidence needed to distinguish correlation from causation.
steps.observation: 光學誤差不一定立即跟隨溫度改變。
steps.observationEn: Optical error may lag temperature changes.
steps.failure: 看到兩條曲線同向就直接宣稱因果不充分。
steps.failureEn: Correlated curves alone do not establish causation.
steps.check: 提出一個替代原因與一個驗證方法。
steps.checkEn: Offer an alternative cause and a verification method.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 結構熱膨脹與熱時間常數會影響定位穩定度。
knowledge.textEn: Structural expansion and thermal time constants affect alignment stability.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 追蹤資料需保留姿態、時間與配置，否則不同情境難以比較。
knowledge.textEn: Trending needs attitude, time and configuration to compare conditions.

quiz.question: 針對「評估熱漂移對鏡面影響」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Assess thermal drift effects on mirrors’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 任一溫度變化都立即同幅改變焦點
應保留時間延遲及其他條件
相關係數等於因果證明
optionsEn: Every temperature change causes an instant proportional focus change
Preserve delays and contextual conditions
Correlation proves causation
quiz.explanation: 結構熱膨脹與熱時間常數會影響定位穩定度。 追蹤資料需保留姿態、時間與配置，否則不同情境難以比較。
quiz.explanationEn: Structural expansion and thermal time constants affect alignment stability. Trending needs attitude, time and configuration to compare conditions.

steps.title: 分配姿態抖動與曝光誤差
steps.objective: 理解動態穩定度如何影響影像。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand how dynamic stability affects images.
steps.instruction: 畫固定星點與抖動軌跡；疊加短與長曝光；比較位移模糊及光子雜訊的權衡。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a stationary star and jitter path; overlay short and long exposures; compare motion blur and photon-noise trade-offs.
steps.observation: 延長曝光可能增加訊號，也累積運動影響。
steps.observationEn: Longer exposure can add signal while integrating motion effects.
steps.failure: 把曝光拉長視為萬用改善方法會失誤。
steps.failureEn: Longer exposure is not a universal remedy.
steps.check: 把光學失焦與姿態模糊分成兩欄。
steps.checkEn: Separate optical defocus from pointing blur.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 影像品質是光學、取樣與時間穩定度共同結果。
knowledge.textEn: Image quality combines optics, sampling and temporal stability.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 曝光影像整合了一段時間內的位置分布；不同頻率的抖動可能在同一平均偏差下產生不同模糊。
knowledge.textEn: An exposure integrates a distribution of positions; different jitter frequencies can produce different blur despite equal mean error.

quiz.question: 針對「分配姿態抖動與曝光誤差」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Allocate jitter and exposure errors’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 曝光無限延長一定最佳
所有模糊都是鏡面形狀問題
曝光應與穩定度一起權衡
optionsEn: Infinite exposure is always optimal
All blur comes from mirror figure
Trade exposure against stability
quiz.explanation: 影像品質是光學、取樣與時間穩定度共同結果。 曝光影像整合了一段時間內的位置分布；不同頻率的抖動可能在同一平均偏差下產生不同模糊。
quiz.explanationEn: Image quality combines optics, sampling and temporal stability. An exposure integrates a distribution of positions; different jitter frequencies can produce different blur despite equal mean error.

stages.title: 試驗、校準與科學資料
stages.description: 讓地面證據與在軌資料互相對照。
stages.descriptionEn: Relate ground evidence to on-orbit data.
stages.route: 先完成前置學習，再提交圖解、推理與檢核證據；每一步均為原創教育任務。
stages.routeEn: Complete the prerequisites, then submit diagrams, reasoning and review evidence; each step is an original educational exercise.

steps.title: 設計地面驗證矩陣
steps.objective: 把環境條件與驗證項目對應。
steps.objectiveEn: Map environmental conditions to verification items.
steps.instruction: 列振動、真空、低溫三種條件；為每項寫一個可驗證主張；指出地面不能完全重現的情況。
steps.instructionEn: List vibration, vacuum and cryogenic conditions; assign a verifiable claim to each; identify conditions not fully reproduced on Earth.
steps.observation: 多個試驗互補，沒有單一全能試驗。
steps.observationEn: Tests complement one another; none establishes everything.
steps.failure: 室溫成功不能直接代表真空低溫成功。
steps.failureEn: Room-temperature success does not prove cryogenic-vacuum success.
steps.check: 每項試驗有配置、環境與接受證據。
steps.checkEn: State configuration, environment and acceptance evidence for each test.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 環境試驗應與分析、檢驗及模型校準共同形成證據鏈。
knowledge.textEn: Environmental tests join analysis, inspection and model calibration in an evidence chain.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 地面重力與邊界條件會引入修正需求；模型誤差仍須列入。
knowledge.textEn: Ground gravity and boundaries require corrections; model error remains part of the assessment.

quiz.question: 針對「設計地面驗證矩陣」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Design a ground-verification matrix’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 不同條件需不同驗證證據
漂亮展開動畫可取代真空試驗
一次試驗可覆蓋所有配置
optionsEn: Different conditions need appropriate evidence
Deployment animation replaces vacuum tests
One test covers every configuration
quiz.explanation: 環境試驗應與分析、檢驗及模型校準共同形成證據鏈。 地面重力與邊界條件會引入修正需求；模型誤差仍須列入。
quiz.explanationEn: Environmental tests join analysis, inspection and model calibration in an evidence chain. Ground gravity and boundaries require corrections; model error remains part of the assessment.

steps.title: 比較縮尺測試與全尺寸系統
steps.titleEn: Compare scaled tests with full-scale systems
steps.objective: 理解縮尺保留與改變的物理量。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand which quantities scaling preserves or changes.
steps.instruction: 選光路、質量與熱時間三個量；列幾何縮小後的變化；標出能直接驗證的演算法問題與不能直接外推的環境問題。
steps.instructionEn: Choose optical path, mass and thermal time; list changes under geometric scaling; distinguish algorithm checks from non-transferable environmental behavior.
steps.observation: 相似外觀不代表所有物理行為相似。
steps.observationEn: Similar appearance does not imply full physical similarity.
steps.failure: 單憑縮尺比例推定全機熱穩定不成立。
steps.failureEn: Scale ratio alone cannot predict full-system thermal stability.
steps.check: 提交一張可外推與不可直接外推表。
steps.checkEn: Submit a transferable/non-directly-transferable table.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 縮尺試驗可隔離演算法或介面問題；全尺寸載荷與材料效應仍需其他證據。
knowledge.textEn: Scaled tests isolate algorithms or interfaces; full-size loads and material effects need additional evidence.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 相似律取決於要驗證的主導物理；幾何縮尺可保留光路概念，卻不自動保留熱時間與重力變形。
knowledge.textEn: Similarity depends on the governing physics; geometric scaling can preserve optical concepts without preserving thermal time or gravitational deformation.

quiz.question: 針對「比較縮尺測試與全尺寸系統」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Compare scaled tests with full-scale systems’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 外型相似即可免除全尺寸驗證
縮尺試驗需明確界定驗證範圍
縮小六倍就讓所有量都縮小六倍
optionsEn: Similar shape removes full-scale verification needs
Define the scope of scaled validation
A sixfold scale change scales every quantity sixfold
quiz.explanation: 縮尺試驗可隔離演算法或介面問題；全尺寸載荷與材料效應仍需其他證據。 相似律取決於要驗證的主導物理；幾何縮尺可保留光路概念，卻不自動保留熱時間與重力變形。
quiz.explanationEn: Scaled tests isolate algorithms or interfaces; full-size loads and material effects need additional evidence. Similarity depends on the governing physics; geometric scaling can preserve optical concepts without preserving thermal time or gravitational deformation.

steps.title: 建立暗訊號與平場校準概念
steps.titleEn: Build dark and flat-field calibration concepts
steps.objective: 把探測器差異與天體訊號分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate detector variation from astronomical signal.
steps.instruction: 建立小型虛構像素矩陣；加入固定偏移與增益差；逐項校正並保留未處理影像作比較。
steps.instructionEn: Create a small synthetic pixel array; add offsets and gain differences; correct them separately and keep the original for comparison.
steps.observation: 相同照明下像素響應可能不同。
steps.observationEn: Pixel responses may differ under equal illumination.
steps.failure: 把所有背景都減成零可能抹掉訊號。
steps.failureEn: Forcing every background to zero can erase signal.
steps.check: 清楚標示原始、校準與顯示轉換三層。
steps.checkEn: Label raw, calibrated and display-transformed layers.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 暗訊號與平場處理針對不同誤差來源，校準必須匹配狀態與波段。
knowledge.textEn: Dark and flat-field corrections address different errors and must match state and band.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 校準參數應保留取得條件與版本；保存原始影像讓日後能檢查校準改動是否引入新的結構。
knowledge.textEn: Keep calibration conditions and versions; retaining raw images allows checking whether calibration changes introduce new structure.

quiz.question: 針對「建立暗訊號與平場校準概念」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Build dark and flat-field calibration concepts’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 任何漂亮圖片都已科學校準
可以刪掉原始數據只留成圖
校準與美化顯示應分開
optionsEn: Every attractive image is scientifically calibrated
Discard raw data and keep only the final image
Separate calibration from display enhancement
quiz.explanation: 暗訊號與平場處理針對不同誤差來源，校準必須匹配狀態與波段。 校準參數應保留取得條件與版本；保存原始影像讓日後能檢查校準改動是否引入新的結構。
quiz.explanationEn: Dark and flat-field corrections address different errors and must match state and band. Keep calibration conditions and versions; retaining raw images allows checking whether calibration changes introduce new structure.

steps.title: 追蹤資料封包到科學產品
steps.objective: 讓每個處理結果都可追溯。
steps.objectiveEn: Make processing results traceable.
steps.instruction: 建立假想資料編號；連結接收時間、校準版本與處理設定；修改一個設定並比較結果及歷程。
steps.instructionEn: Create hypothetical data IDs; link receipt time, calibration version and processing settings; change one setting and compare output and provenance.
steps.observation: 結果變化可能來自處理版本而非天體。
