steps.observationEn: Output changes may come from processing rather than the sky.
steps.failure: 只保存最後圖片無法重現推論。
steps.failureEn: A final image alone cannot reproduce an inference.
steps.check: 記錄輸入、版本、設定與輸出校驗碼。
steps.checkEn: Record inputs, versions, settings and output checksums.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 資料履歷讓科學與軟體變更可區分，並支持重新處理。
knowledge.textEn: Provenance separates scientific changes from software changes and supports reprocessing.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 保留處理歷程不會自動證明模型正確，仍需獨立校準驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Provenance does not itself prove model correctness; independent calibration checks remain necessary.

quiz.question: 針對「追蹤資料封包到科學產品」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Trace packets to science products’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 版本與輸入應伴隨輸出保存
檔名相同代表內容不變
重新處理一定代表觀測錯誤
optionsEn: Preserve versions and inputs with outputs
Matching filenames prove identical content
Reprocessing always means the observation was wrong
quiz.explanation: 資料履歷讓科學與軟體變更可區分，並支持重新處理。 保留處理歷程不會自動證明模型正確，仍需獨立校準驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: Provenance separates scientific changes from software changes and supports reprocessing. Provenance does not itself prove model correctness; independent calibration checks remain necessary.

steps.title: 用誤差與反證閱讀科學影像
steps.titleEn: Read images with uncertainty and counterchecks
steps.objective: 避免把處理痕跡當新天體。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid mistaking processing artifacts for objects.
steps.instruction: 在虛構影像加入一個異常像素；比較相鄰曝光；提出訊號、儀器與處理三種解釋並標證據不足處。
steps.instructionEn: Add one anomalous pixel to a synthetic image; compare adjacent exposures; propose sky, detector and processing explanations and mark evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 異常特徵需要跨資料交叉檢查。
steps.observationEn: Anomalies need checks across data.
steps.failure: 只選最漂亮的一張支持結論會偏誤。
steps.failureEn: Selecting only the most attractive image biases conclusions.
steps.check: 至少列兩個競爭解釋及可區分的觀測。
steps.checkEn: List competing explanations and a discriminating observation.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 科學影像包含噪聲、偵測器效應與處理選擇，不能把每個像素當確定物理物件。
knowledge.textEn: Images include noise, detector effects and processing choices; not every pixel is a certain physical object.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 不確定性與重複觀察是推論的一部分，不是失敗的裝飾。
knowledge.textEn: Uncertainty and repeat observation are part of inference, not decorative caveats.

quiz.question: 針對「用誤差與反證閱讀科學影像」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Read images with uncertainty and counterchecks’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 調色後變明顯就能證明真實
跨曝光與處理條件核對異常
單一亮點必然是新發現
optionsEn: Greater visibility after recoloring proves reality
Check anomalies across exposures and processing conditions
One bright pixel guarantees a discovery
quiz.explanation: 科學影像包含噪聲、偵測器效應與處理選擇，不能把每個像素當確定物理物件。 不確定性與重複觀察是推論的一部分，不是失敗的裝飾。
quiz.explanationEn: Images include noise, detector effects and processing choices; not every pixel is a certain physical object. Uncertainty and repeat observation are part of inference, not decorative caveats.

steps.title: 審查 Webb 與相關光學工程
steps.titleEn: Review Webb and related optical engineering
steps.objective: 找出可遷移原理與不能照搬的条件。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify transferable principles and non-transferable conditions.
steps.instruction: 比較 Webb、Landsat 與地面消色差鏡頭；列出共同的光學校準問題；再分開波段、環境與熱設計差異。
steps.instructionEn: Compare Webb, Landsat and an achromatic lens; list shared calibration problems; separate spectral, environmental and thermal differences.
steps.observation: 都用光學不表示材料、鍍膜或校準完全相同。
steps.observationEn: Shared optics do not imply identical materials, coatings or calibration.
steps.failure: 把太空紅外方法直接當地面鏡頭配方會誤用。
steps.failureEn: Applying space-infrared methods as terrestrial lens recipes misuses the comparison.
steps.check: 總結必須含共同原理、差異與證據界限。
steps.checkEn: Include common principles, differences and evidence limits in the review.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 收光、像差、熱漂移與可追溯校準是跨工程的共通問題。
knowledge.textEn: Collection, aberration, thermal drift and traceable calibration recur across optical projects.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: Webb 採反射式分段主鏡；消色差折射鏡靠不同色散材料處理另一類問題。
knowledge.textEn: Webb uses a segmented reflecting primary; achromatic refractors use different dispersions to address a different problem.

quiz.question: 針對「審查 Webb 與相關光學工程」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Review Webb and related optical engineering’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 所有光學器件可用同一材料配方
反射鏡與折射鏡的色散機制相同
比較原理時也要標明環境差異
optionsEn: Every optic uses the same material recipe
Mirrors and refractors have identical dispersion mechanisms
Mark environmental differences when comparing principles
quiz.explanation: 收光、像差、熱漂移與可追溯校準是跨工程的共通問題。 Webb 採反射式分段主鏡；消色差折射鏡靠不同色散材料處理另一類問題。
quiz.explanationEn: Collection, aberration, thermal drift and traceable calibration recur across optical projects. Webb uses a segmented reflecting primary; achromatic refractors use different dispersions to address a different problem.

courses.title: 道格灘離岸風電場
courses.summary: 以二十四個工程任務串接場址、單樁、轉子、海纜、HVDC 與可維護性。
courses.summaryEn: Twenty-four tasks connect site conditions, monopiles, rotors, cables, HVDC and maintainability.
courses.scope: 以 Dogger Bank 分期工程公開資料為案例，數值與載荷圖均是教學假設；不是打樁、起重、海事作業或高壓送電指令。歷史只引用已公布里程碑，不宣稱全風場現已完工。
courses.scopeEn: Uses public information about phased Dogger Bank construction; numerical examples and loads are teaching assumptions, not piling, lifting, marine-operation or high-voltage energization instructions. History states published milestones without claiming whole-farm completion.

stages.title: 風況、場址與設計邊界
stages.description: 將自然條件轉成可追溯的設計假設。
stages.descriptionEn: Translate natural conditions into traceable assumptions.
stages.route: 先完成前置學習，再提交圖解、推理與檢核證據；每一步均為原創教育任務。
stages.routeEn: Complete the prerequisites, then submit diagrams, reasoning and review evidence; each step is an original educational exercise.

steps.title: 讀取風速分布而非單一平均
steps.titleEn: Read wind distributions rather than one mean
steps.objective: 了解平均風速不足以描述發電。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand why mean wind alone is insufficient.
steps.instruction: 建立低、中、高三段假想風速頻率；比較平均值相同的兩組分布；寫下發電估算仍缺的資料。
steps.instructionEn: Build low, medium and high hypothetical wind bins; compare distributions with equal means; list missing generation-estimation data.
steps.observation: 相同平均值可能對應不同能量機會。
steps.observationEn: Equal means can correspond to different energy opportunities.
steps.failure: 用平均風速直接代入全年輸出會偏差。
steps.failureEn: Using mean speed directly for annual output can bias estimates.
steps.check: 保留頻率、時間範圍與量測高度。
steps.checkEn: Preserve frequency, period and measurement height.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 風中可用功率理想上與風速立方相關，但真實風機有功率曲線與運作限制。
knowledge.textEn: Ideal available wind power scales with speed cubed, but real turbines have power curves and operating limits.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 風資源估計還需空氣密度、方向與長期代表性。
knowledge.textEn: Resource estimates also need air density, direction and long-term representativeness.

quiz.question: 針對「讀取風速分布而非單一平均」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Read wind distributions rather than one mean’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 應用風速分布與適用功率曲線
平均風速就是全年發電量
風越強就可無限制輸出
optionsEn: Use wind distributions and an applicable power curve
Mean speed equals annual generation
Stronger wind allows unlimited output
quiz.explanation: 風中可用功率理想上與風速立方相關，但真實風機有功率曲線與運作限制。 風資源估計還需空氣密度、方向與長期代表性。
quiz.explanationEn: Ideal available wind power scales with speed cubed, but real turbines have power curves and operating limits. Resource estimates also need air density, direction and long-term representativeness.

steps.title: 區分風場分期與發電里程碑
steps.objective: 正確閱讀大型工程進度。
steps.objectiveEn: Read major-project progress correctly.
steps.instruction: 畫 A、B、C 三區；為首次發電、單區完成與全部完成建立不同欄位；把有日期的官方公告對應到正確欄。
steps.instructionEn: Draw A, B and C; separate first power, phase completion and whole-project completion; assign dated official announcements to the correct fields.
steps.observation: 一台發電不代表所有風機均已運轉。
steps.observationEn: One generating turbine does not establish fleet-wide operation.
steps.failure: 把首電新聞標題改寫成全案完工不正確。
steps.failureEn: Rewriting first-power news as whole-project completion is wrong.
steps.check: 每個進度主張都附區別與日期。
steps.checkEn: Attach scope and date to each progress claim.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 分期工程有不同土建、機電與併網進度，容量目標不等於已投運容量。
knowledge.textEn: Phases have different civil, mechanical and grid milestones; target capacity is not commissioned capacity.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 2023 年首電是歷史事實，本課未據此推定 2026 年全部完工。
knowledge.textEn: First power in 2023 is a historical event, not evidence here of complete delivery in 2026.

quiz.question: 針對「區分風場分期與發電里程碑」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Distinguish phases from generation milestones’, which conclusion is justified?
options: A 區海纜完工代表 C 區也完工
首次發電與全案完成應分開
總規劃容量就是目前輸出
optionsEn: Phase A cables imply phase C completion
Separate first power from total completion
Planned capacity equals current output
quiz.explanation: 分期工程有不同土建、機電與併網進度，容量目標不等於已投運容量。 2023 年首電是歷史事實，本課未據此推定 2026 年全部完工。
quiz.explanationEn: Phases have different civil, mechanical and grid milestones; target capacity is not commissioned capacity. First power in 2023 is a historical event, not evidence here of complete delivery in 2026.

steps.title: 建立海床地形與地層剖面
steps.objective: 分清水深與基礎承載條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate water depth from foundation conditions.
steps.instruction: 畫三個假想測點的海床高程；另畫分層土壤；標出點間推估區域與需補勘的空白。
steps.instructionEn: Draw seabed elevations at three hypothetical points; add soil layers; mark interpolated areas and investigation gaps.
steps.observation: 海床平坦不代表地層均勻。
steps.observationEn: A flat seabed does not imply uniform soil.
steps.failure: 把一個鑽孔套用全風場會過度推論。
steps.failureEn: Applying one borehole to an entire farm overreaches.
steps.check: 剖面明確區分已量測與推估。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish measured and inferred profile portions.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 基礎反應涉及地層剛度、強度與循環行為，而不只是水深。
knowledge.textEn: Foundation response involves soil stiffness, strength and cyclic behavior, not depth alone.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 測點間的地層推估包含空間不確定度；差異較大的區域可能需要更多勘查以降低模型風險。
knowledge.textEn: Soil interpolation between points carries spatial uncertainty; highly variable areas may need more investigation to reduce model risk.

quiz.question: 針對「建立海床地形與地層剖面」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Build bathymetry and soil profiles’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 水深相同代表所有地層相同
一個測點足以代表所有樁位
地形與地質要分開檢查
optionsEn: Equal depth proves identical soil
One point represents every pile location
Review bathymetry and geology separately
quiz.explanation: 基礎反應涉及地層剛度、強度與循環行為，而不只是水深。 測點間的地層推估包含空間不確定度；差異較大的區域可能需要更多勘查以降低模型風險。
quiz.explanationEn: Foundation response involves soil stiffness, strength and cyclic behavior, not depth alone. Soil interpolation between points carries spatial uncertainty; highly variable areas may need more investigation to reduce model risk.

steps.title: 比較風機間距與尾流
steps.objective: 了解上游風機改變下游條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand upstream effects on downstream turbines.
steps.instruction: 畫兩列教學風機與主風向；標尾流陰影；轉換風向再比較受影響機位與海纜長度。
steps.instructionEn: Draw two teaching rows and prevailing wind; shade wakes; rotate the wind and compare affected positions and cable lengths.
steps.observation: 發電、載荷與海纜成本可能互相牽動。
steps.observationEn: Energy, loads and cable cost may interact.
steps.failure: 只追求最近距離可能增加尾流損失。
steps.failureEn: Minimizing spacing can increase wake losses.
steps.check: 列出兩個布局方案及各自權衡。
steps.checkEn: List two layouts and their trade-offs.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 尾流包含速度虧損與湍流變化，並非固定不變的幾何陰影。
knowledge.textEn: Wakes involve velocity deficits and turbulence changes, not fixed geometric shadows.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 真實布局需風況、環境、海床與電氣整合模型；簡圖僅供比較。
knowledge.textEn: Real layouts need wind, environment, seabed and electrical models; sketches support comparison only.

quiz.question: 針對「比較風機間距與尾流」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Compare spacing and wakes’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 布局要同時比較風向與電氣距離
每台額定功率直接相加就是年發電
尾流永遠朝同一方向
optionsEn: Compare wind direction and electrical distance
Summed ratings equal annual energy
Wakes always point in one direction
quiz.explanation: 尾流包含速度虧損與湍流變化，並非固定不變的幾何陰影。 真實布局需風況、環境、海床與電氣整合模型；簡圖僅供比較。
quiz.explanationEn: Wakes involve velocity deficits and turbulence changes, not fixed geometric shadows. Real layouts need wind, environment, seabed and electrical models; sketches support comparison only.

steps.title: 畫出風浪流的共同載荷路徑
steps.titleEn: Trace combined wind, wave and current loads
steps.objective: 把自然作用連到塔架與地基。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect natural actions to tower and soil.
steps.instruction: 在風機剖面標風、浪與流；追蹤力矩至單樁；列出同向與不同向的假想組合。
steps.instructionEn: Mark wind, waves and current on a section; trace moments to the monopile; list hypothetical aligned and misaligned combinations.
steps.observation: 最大單一載荷不必出现在同一時刻。
steps.observationEn: Individual load maxima need not occur simultaneously.
steps.failure: 任意相加所有最大值可能失真。
steps.failureEn: Arbitrarily summing all maxima can misrepresent conditions.
steps.check: 保留載荷方向、時序與組合假設。
steps.checkEn: Preserve direction, timing and combination assumptions.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 海上結構面對多源動態作用，組合需物理與機率背景。
knowledge.textEn: Offshore structures face multiple dynamic actions whose combinations need physical and probabilistic context.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 載荷的方向與相位影響合力矩，設計情境應區分極端事件與長期循環，因為兩者回答不同問題。
knowledge.textEn: Load direction and phase affect resultant moments; extreme-event and long-term cyclic scenarios address different questions.

quiz.question: 針對「畫出風浪流的共同載荷路徑」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Trace combined wind, wave and current loads’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 海流只影響發電不影響基礎
載荷組合需說明相依性
所有最大值必然同時發生
optionsEn: Current affects generation but not foundations
State dependencies in load combinations
All maxima necessarily coincide
quiz.explanation: 海上結構面對多源動態作用，組合需物理與機率背景。 載荷的方向與相位影響合力矩，設計情境應區分極端事件與長期循環，因為兩者回答不同問題。
quiz.explanationEn: Offshore structures face multiple dynamic actions whose combinations need physical and probabilistic context. Load direction and phase affect resultant moments; extreme-event and long-term cyclic scenarios address different questions.

steps.title: 界定能源與可用率預算
steps.objective: 分清功率、電量與停機損失。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate power, energy and downtime losses.
steps.instruction: 用假設額定功率乘時間建立上限；分列尾流、電損與停機；檢查各項是否重複扣除。
steps.instructionEn: Form an upper bound from assumed rating and time; separate wake, electrical and downtime losses; check for double counting.
steps.observation: MW 與 MWh 表達不同物理量。
steps.observationEn: MW and MWh represent different quantities.
steps.failure: 把裝置容量當全年電量會單位錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Treating capacity as annual energy is a unit error.
steps.check: 完成有單位與損失定義的預算。
steps.checkEn: Produce a budget with units and defined losses.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 容量因數與可用率不同；可用但無風的風機仍可能不發電。
knowledge.textEn: Capacity factor differs from availability; an available turbine may produce nothing in calm conditions.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 發電估計必須標期間與假設，不能當固定收益保證。
knowledge.textEn: Generation estimates need a period and assumptions and are not guaranteed returns.

quiz.question: 針對「界定能源與可用率預算」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Define energy and availability budgets’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 可用率百分之百就一定滿發
MW 與 MWh 可互相替代
分開容量因數與設備可用率
optionsEn: Full availability implies full-rated output
MW and MWh are interchangeable
Separate capacity factor from availability
quiz.explanation: 容量因數與可用率不同；可用但無風的風機仍可能不發電。 發電估計必須標期間與假設，不能當固定收益保證。
quiz.explanationEn: Capacity factor differs from availability; an available turbine may produce nothing in calm conditions. Generation estimates need a period and assumptions and are not guaranteed returns.

stages.title: 基礎、轉子與機械可靠度
stages.description: 追蹤受力、疲勞、腐蝕與維護介面。
stages.descriptionEn: Trace loading, fatigue, corrosion and maintenance interfaces.
stages.route: 先完成前置學習，再提交圖解、推理與檢核證據；每一步均為原創教育任務。
stages.routeEn: Complete the prerequisites, then submit diagrams, reasoning and review evidence; each step is an original educational exercise.

steps.title: 檢查單樁的結構與土壤介面
steps.objective: 理解基礎固定並非理想剛接。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand that foundation restraint is not perfectly rigid.
steps.instruction: 畫單樁與分布土反力；比較軟硬兩種假想地層；標塔頂位移與固有頻率可能改變的方向。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a monopile and distributed soil reactions; compare hypothetical soft and stiff soils; mark possible changes in tower-top motion and natural frequency.
steps.observation: 土壤反應會影響整體動態。
steps.observationEn: Soil response affects whole-system dynamics.
steps.failure: 把海床下端永遠視為完全固定會簡化過度。
steps.failureEn: Assuming a perfectly fixed buried end can oversimplify.
steps.check: 列出模型邊界及敏感參數。
steps.checkEn: List model boundaries and sensitive parameters.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 樁土互制把基礎與上部結構耦合，循環載荷可能改變有效反應。
knowledge.textEn: Soil–pile interaction couples foundation and superstructure; cycles may alter effective response.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 海床附近的側向反力分布影響彎矩與轉角；土層厚度相同也不保證具有相同的等效剛度。
knowledge.textEn: Lateral reaction distribution near the seabed affects moment and rotation; equal layer thickness does not imply equal effective stiffness.

quiz.question: 針對「檢查單樁的結構與土壤介面」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Review the monopile–soil interface’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 應檢查土壤假設對動態的影響
基礎永遠不動所以不需建模
只看樁重即可決定承載
optionsEn: Examine soil assumptions in dynamic behavior
Foundations never move and need no model
Pile weight alone determines capacity
quiz.explanation: 樁土互制把基礎與上部結構耦合，循環載荷可能改變有效反應。 海床附近的側向反力分布影響彎矩與轉角；土層厚度相同也不保證具有相同的等效剛度。
quiz.explanationEn: Soil–pile interaction couples foundation and superstructure; cycles may alter effective response. Lateral reaction distribution near the seabed affects moment and rotation; equal layer thickness does not imply equal effective stiffness.

steps.title: 追蹤過渡段與塔架接合
steps.objective: 辨識接頭、通行與設備介面。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify joint, access and equipment interfaces.
steps.instruction: 在剖面中分出單樁、過渡段與塔架；標載荷傳遞；另用虛線標設備與人員通行路徑。
steps.instructionEn: Separate monopile, transition piece and tower in a section; mark load transfer; use dashed lines for equipment and access paths.
steps.observation: 同一幾何介面同時服務結構與維護。
steps.observationEn: One geometric interface can serve structure and maintenance.
steps.failure: 只畫載荷不留可檢查性會造成設計盲點。
steps.failureEn: Load-only drawings can overlook inspectability.
steps.check: 至少指出一處需同時滿足承載與維護的區域。
steps.checkEn: Identify an area serving both load and maintenance needs.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 接合細節需管理接觸、預力與疲勞等問題，不能只靠外形吻合。
knowledge.textEn: Joint detail must address contact, preload and fatigue, not appearance alone.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 接頭的局部接觸狀態可能影響載荷分配；圖面審查需同時保留連接區與量測可達性的描述。
knowledge.textEn: Local joint contact can alter load sharing; reviews should preserve both connection details and measurement access.

quiz.question: 針對「追蹤過渡段與塔架接合」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Trace transition-piece and tower interfaces’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 維護通道永遠與結構無關
結構與維護需求要共同審查
接頭看起來密合就代表全部合格
optionsEn: Access never interacts with structure
Review structural and maintenance needs together
A close-looking fit proves full compliance
quiz.explanation: 接合細節需管理接觸、預力與疲勞等問題，不能只靠外形吻合。 接頭的局部接觸狀態可能影響載荷分配；圖面審查需同時保留連接區與量測可達性的描述。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint detail must address contact, preload and fatigue, not appearance alone. Local joint contact can alter load sharing; reviews should preserve both connection details and measurement access.

steps.title: 分解葉片的升力與彎曲
steps.objective: 把氣動力連到葉根載荷。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect aerodynamic forces to root loads.
steps.instruction: 在示意葉片標三段分布力；畫合力與葉根力矩；改變外段力並比較對根部的影響。
steps.instructionEn: Mark loads on three blade spans; draw resultant and root moment; change an outer-span load and compare root effects.
steps.observation: 遠端載荷因力臂而影響彎矩。
steps.observationEn: Outboard loads influence bending through leverage.
steps.failure: 只比合力會忽略分布位置。
steps.failureEn: Comparing resultant force alone ignores distribution.
steps.check: 能說明相同合力為何產生不同力矩。
steps.checkEn: Explain why equal forces can produce different moments.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 葉片需要在氣動效率、剛度、重量與疲勞間權衡。
knowledge.textEn: Blades trade aerodynamic efficiency, stiffness, mass and fatigue performance.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 葉片扭轉會改變局部迎角，再回饋到氣動力；只用剛性直梁模型會遺漏這類耦合。
knowledge.textEn: Blade twist changes local angle of attack and aerodynamic force; a rigid straight-beam model misses this coupling.

quiz.question: 針對「分解葉片的升力與彎曲」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Decompose blade lift and bending’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 只有合力大小重要
葉片越重就永遠效率越好
分布位置影響根部彎矩
optionsEn: Only total force matters
Heavier blades always improve efficiency
Load position affects root moment
quiz.explanation: 葉片需要在氣動效率、剛度、重量與疲勞間權衡。 葉片扭轉會改變局部迎角，再回饋到氣動力；只用剛性直梁模型會遺漏這類耦合。
quiz.explanationEn: Blades trade aerodynamic efficiency, stiffness, mass and fatigue performance. Blade twist changes local angle of attack and aerodynamic force; a rigid straight-beam model misses this coupling.

steps.title: 比較模態與週期激振
steps.objective: 了解動態頻率避開的重要性。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand dynamic frequency separation.
steps.instruction: 畫一條假想結構頻率與轉速區間；加入轉動及葉片通過頻率概念線；標出需詳細分析的接近區域。
steps.instructionEn: Draw an assumed structural frequency and speed range; add conceptual rotor and blade-passing frequency lines; flag close approaches for analysis.
steps.observation: 頻率接近可能增加振動風險。
steps.observationEn: Nearby frequencies can increase vibration risk.
steps.failure: 只驗證靜態承載不足以涵蓋共振問題。
steps.failureEn: Static load checks do not cover resonance.
steps.check: 所有頻率均標單位與假設。
steps.checkEn: Label units and assumptions on every frequency.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 模態反映質量與剛度分布，基礎、塔架與轉子共同影響系統。
knowledge.textEn: Modes reflect mass and stiffness distribution across foundation, tower and rotor.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 頻率接近不等於必然失效，仍需阻尼、激振與響應評估。
knowledge.textEn: Frequency proximity does not guarantee failure; damping, excitation and response matter.

quiz.question: 針對「比較模態與週期激振」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Compare modes and periodic excitation’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 需進一步檢查阻尼與激振
頻率接近就能直接宣判倒塌
靜態強度足夠就沒有動態問題
optionsEn: Examine damping and excitation further
Frequency proximity alone proves collapse
Static strength eliminates dynamic concerns
quiz.explanation: 模態反映質量與剛度分布，基礎、塔架與轉子共同影響系統。 頻率接近不等於必然失效，仍需阻尼、激振與響應評估。
quiz.explanationEn: Modes reflect mass and stiffness distribution across foundation, tower and rotor. Frequency proximity does not guarantee failure; damping, excitation and response matter.

steps.title: 建立疲勞事件與量測紀錄
steps.objective: 將重複載荷轉為可追蹤問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Turn repeated loads into traceable questions.
steps.instruction: 畫兩段不同幅度的虛構應變歷程；標記循環範例；列感測器漂移與資料缺漏對解釋的影響。
steps.instructionEn: Draw two synthetic strain histories with different amplitudes; mark example cycles; list effects of drift and missing data.
steps.observation: 小載荷大量循環也可能影響壽命。
steps.observationEn: Many small cycles can affect lifetime.
steps.failure: 只保存最大值會丟失循環歷史。
steps.failureEn: Saving only maxima loses cyclic history.
steps.check: 保留時間序列、校準與工況標記。
steps.checkEn: Preserve time series, calibration and operating-state labels.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 疲勞評估需載荷譜與材料/接頭資料，不能僅靠一個峰值。
knowledge.textEn: Fatigue assessment needs load spectra and material/joint data, not one peak.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 循環計數必須連到應力估計與材料資料；感測位置不同，即使峰值相同也未必代表相同損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Cycle counts must link to stress estimates and material data; equal peaks at different sensor positions need not imply equal damage.

quiz.question: 針對「建立疲勞事件與量測紀錄」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Build fatigue-event and measurement records’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 感測器漂移與壽命估計無關
循環幅度與次數都要考慮
只要最大值未超限就不會疲勞
optionsEn: Sensor drift never affects life estimates
Consider cycle magnitude and count
No overload means no fatigue
quiz.explanation: 疲勞評估需載荷譜與材料/接頭資料，不能僅靠一個峰值。 循環計數必須連到應力估計與材料資料；感測位置不同，即使峰值相同也未必代表相同損傷。
quiz.explanationEn: Fatigue assessment needs load spectra and material/joint data, not one peak. Cycle counts must link to stress estimates and material data; equal peaks at different sensor positions need not imply equal damage.

steps.title: 比較防蝕與可檢查性
steps.objective: 把海洋環境納入材料證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Include the marine environment in material evidence.
steps.instruction: 在潮差、飛濺與浸水區分色；列各區觀察項目；比較完好與破損塗層的假想檢查紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Color tidal, splash and submerged zones; list observations for each; compare hypothetical intact and damaged coating records.
steps.observation: 不同環境區需要不同觀察重點。
steps.observationEn: Environmental zones need different inspection emphasis.
steps.failure: 只看塔頂照片無法代表水下狀態。
steps.failureEn: A tower-top photo cannot establish underwater condition.
steps.check: 指出不可直接觀察的部位及所需證據。
steps.checkEn: Identify inaccessible areas and required evidence.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 腐蝕防護涉及材料、塗層、電化學保護與可維護性等系統因素。
knowledge.textEn: Corrosion protection combines material, coatings, electrochemical protection and maintainability.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 表面觀察不能單獨量化全部剩餘厚度或內部損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Surface observation alone cannot quantify all remaining thickness or internal damage.

quiz.question: 針對「比較防蝕與可檢查性」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Compare corrosion protection and inspectability’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 任何白色塗層都完全等效
沒有表面鏽斑就一定毫無損傷
不同海洋區域應分別記錄
optionsEn: Every white coating is equivalent
No surface rust guarantees no damage
Record marine zones separately
quiz.explanation: 腐蝕防護涉及材料、塗層、電化學保護與可維護性等系統因素。 表面觀察不能單獨量化全部剩餘厚度或內部損傷。
quiz.explanationEn: Corrosion protection combines material, coatings, electrochemical protection and maintainability. Surface observation alone cannot quantify all remaining thickness or internal damage.

stages.title: 集電、海纜與 HVDC
stages.description: 分清交流集電與直流輸電的不同功能。
stages.descriptionEn: Separate AC collection from DC export.
stages.route: 先完成前置學習，再提交圖解、推理與檢核證據；每一步均為原創教育任務。
stages.routeEn: Complete the prerequisites, then submit diagrams, reasoning and review evidence; each step is an original educational exercise.

steps.title: 畫出交流集電拓樸
steps.objective: 理解多風機與海上站的連接。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand turbine-to-offshore-station connections.
steps.instruction: 用五台假想風機畫兩種集電支路；標每段功率匯集；移除一段海纜並比較受影響機位。
steps.instructionEn: Draw two collection branches for five hypothetical turbines; mark accumulated power; remove one cable segment and compare affected turbines.
steps.observation: 靠近匯集點的線段可能承擔更多輸送。
steps.observationEn: Segments near collection points may carry more power.
steps.failure: 把每段電纜負載都當一台風機會低估。
steps.failureEn: Assuming one-turbine loading on every segment underestimates aggregation.
steps.check: 每條支路具輸入、匯流與失效影響。
steps.checkEn: Show inputs, aggregation and failure impact on each branch.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: Dogger Bank A 公開資料區分陣列交流海纜與後續直流外送。
knowledge.textEn: Public Dogger Bank A material distinguishes AC array cables from subsequent DC export.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 不同集電拓樸改變單點故障的影響範圍與電纜長度；供電冗餘與維修成本需一起比較。
knowledge.textEn: Collection topology changes single-failure scope and cable length; redundancy and repair cost must be compared together.

quiz.question: 針對「畫出交流集電拓樸」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Draw AC collection topology’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 線段負載需按上游匯流計算
每條海纜永遠只載一台容量
所有海纜都是同一種直流功能
optionsEn: Account for aggregated upstream loading
Every cable always carries one turbine’s rating
All cables have the same DC function
quiz.explanation: Dogger Bank A 公開資料區分陣列交流海纜與後續直流外送。 不同集電拓樸改變單點故障的影響範圍與電纜長度；供電冗餘與維修成本需一起比較。
quiz.explanationEn: Public Dogger Bank A material distinguishes AC array cables from subsequent DC export. Collection topology changes single-failure scope and cable length; redundancy and repair cost must be compared together.

steps.title: 分開電纜電流與熱限制
steps.titleEn: Separate cable current and thermal limits
steps.objective: 把導體損失連到海床散熱。
steps.objectiveEn: Link conductor loss to seabed heat transfer.
steps.instruction: 設兩個假想電流值；用 I²R 比較同阻抗損失；再改海床熱條件並列出載流量仍缺的資料。
steps.instructionEn: Choose two hypothetical currents; compare I²R losses at one resistance; change seabed thermal conditions and list missing ampacity inputs.
steps.observation: 同一電纜在不同散熱條件下限制可能不同。
steps.observationEn: One cable can have different limits under different cooling conditions.
steps.failure: 只憑導體截面判定所有場址載流量不夠。
steps.failureEn: Cross-section alone does not establish ampacity at every site.
steps.check: 報表列電流、阻值、熱邊界與假設。
steps.checkEn: Report current, resistance, thermal boundary and assumptions.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 電阻損失隨電流平方增長，溫度又可能改變導體電阻。
knowledge.textEn: Resistive loss scales with current squared, and temperature can alter resistance.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 海纜設計還需埋設、交越與材料資料；此處不提供實際額定值。
knowledge.textEn: Cable design needs burial, crossing and material data; no real ratings are supplied.

quiz.question: 針對「分開電纜電流與熱限制」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Separate cable current and thermal limits’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 電流加倍損失永遠只加倍
熱邊界與電流都會影響限制
截面相同就處處同額定值
optionsEn: Doubling current only doubles loss
Thermal boundaries and current both affect limits
Equal sections have equal ratings everywhere
quiz.explanation: 電阻損失隨電流平方增長，溫度又可能改變導體電阻。 海纜設計還需埋設、交越與材料資料；此處不提供實際額定值。
quiz.explanationEn: Resistive loss scales with current squared, and temperature can alter resistance. Cable design needs burial, crossing and material data; no real ratings are supplied.

steps.title: 辨識海纜路由與機械保護
steps.titleEn: Identify cable routing and mechanical protection
steps.objective: 了解路由是多因素約束。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand routing as a multi-constraint problem.
steps.instruction: 在示意海圖標海床起伏與交越；畫兩條候選路由；比較長度、維修可達性及需要補查的環境資料。
steps.instructionEn: Mark relief and crossings on a schematic chart; draw candidate routes; compare length, repair access and missing environmental data.
steps.observation: 最短路由未必是最低整體風險。
steps.observationEn: The shortest route may not minimize overall risk.
steps.failure: 忽略交越或可維修性會失去關鍵約束。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring crossings or repair access loses key constraints.
steps.check: 每條路由至少列三項權衡。
steps.checkEn: List at least three trade-offs per route.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 海纜同時承擔電氣、機械與環境要求；路由選擇不能只最佳化距離。
knowledge.textEn: Cables carry electrical, mechanical and environmental requirements; distance alone is insufficient.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 彎曲、局部支撐與交越可能改變機械負擔及散熱；地圖距離相同的路徑仍可能有不同工程難度。
knowledge.textEn: Bending, support and crossings affect mechanical loading and cooling; equal map distances can have different engineering difficulty.

quiz.question: 針對「辨識海纜路由與機械保護」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Identify cable routing and mechanical protection’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 最短路線必然最佳
海床資訊只影響外觀
應同時比較交越與維修條件
optionsEn: The shortest route is always best
Seabed data only affects appearance
Compare crossing and repair conditions together
quiz.explanation: 海纜同時承擔電氣、機械與環境要求；路由選擇不能只最佳化距離。 彎曲、局部支撐與交越可能改變機械負擔及散熱；地圖距離相同的路徑仍可能有不同工程難度。
quiz.explanationEn: Cables carry electrical, mechanical and environmental requirements; distance alone is insufficient. Bending, support and crossings affect mechanical loading and cooling; equal map distances can have different engineering difficulty.

steps.title: 說明 AC—DC—AC 能量鏈
steps.objective: 辨識換流器與變壓器的不同。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish converters from transformers.
steps.instruction: 畫交流集電、海上換流、直流輸送與陸上換流；為各節點標電能形式；另畫變壓器並說明功能差異。
steps.instructionEn: Draw AC collection, offshore conversion, DC export and onshore conversion; label electrical form at each node; add a transformer and distinguish its role.
steps.observation: 改變電壓與改變交流/直流形式不是同一件事。
steps.observationEn: Changing voltage and converting AC/DC are different functions.
steps.failure: 只放變壓器就聲稱產生 HVDC 不成立。
steps.failureEn: A transformer alone does not create HVDC.
steps.check: 完整鏈含轉換與輸送損失註記。
steps.checkEn: Annotate conversion and transmission losses along the chain.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: HVDC 在長距離海纜工程中可提供系統選擇，但換流站增加成本、控制與散熱要求。
knowledge.textEn: HVDC offers an option for long submarine links, with converter cost, control and cooling needs.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 換流站也有電能損失與散熱負載；完整效率預算應包含兩端站與外送線，不只算海纜。
knowledge.textEn: Converter stations add losses and cooling loads; the efficiency budget includes both terminals and the export link, not just cable.

quiz.question: 針對「說明 AC—DC—AC 能量鏈」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Explain the AC–DC–AC energy chain’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 變壓器與換流器需分開表示
變壓器即可把所有 AC 變成 DC
直流輸送沒有任何損失
optionsEn: Represent transformers and converters separately
A transformer alone converts AC to DC
DC transmission has no losses
quiz.explanation: HVDC 在長距離海纜工程中可提供系統選擇，但換流站增加成本、控制與散熱要求。 換流站也有電能損失與散熱負載；完整效率預算應包含兩端站與外送線，不只算海纜。
quiz.explanationEn: HVDC offers an option for long submarine links, with converter cost, control and cooling needs. Converter stations add losses and cooling loads; the efficiency budget includes both terminals and the export link, not just cable.

steps.title: 分析保護分區與失效隔離
steps.titleEn: Analyze protection zones and fault isolation
steps.objective: 理解故障影響的邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand fault-containment boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在教學能量鏈畫三個分區；標故障觀察與隔離邊界；模擬一個區域不可用時哪些資料需再確認。
steps.instructionEn: Draw three zones on the teaching chain; mark observations and isolation boundaries; simulate one unavailable zone and list data to reconfirm.
steps.observation: 隔離設備動作仍需狀態證據。
steps.observationEn: Isolation action still needs state evidence.
steps.failure: 把畫面變灰當成真實斷電會混淆。
steps.failureEn: A gray display is not proof of de-energization.
steps.check: 分開教學狀態、現場電氣狀態與未知。
steps.checkEn: Separate teaching state, physical state and unknown status.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 保護協調要讓選擇性、快速性與系統穩定互相配合。
knowledge.textEn: Protection coordination balances selectivity, speed and system stability.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 監控電源或通訊的共用故障可能同時影響多區觀察；分區圖應標示這些非主功率依賴。
knowledge.textEn: Shared monitoring-power or communication failures can affect several zones; diagrams should show these non-power dependencies.

quiz.question: 針對「分析保護分區與失效隔離」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Analyze protection zones and fault isolation’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 所有分區永遠可各自無依賴運作
隔離主張需要獨立狀態證據
畫面不亮就能判定無電
optionsEn: All zones operate without dependencies
Isolation claims need independent state evidence
A dark display proves no voltage
quiz.explanation: 保護協調要讓選擇性、快速性與系統穩定互相配合。 監控電源或通訊的共用故障可能同時影響多區觀察；分區圖應標示這些非主功率依賴。
quiz.explanationEn: Protection coordination balances selectivity, speed and system stability. Shared monitoring-power or communication failures can affect several zones; diagrams should show these non-power dependencies.

steps.title: 建立併網與電能品質問題單
steps.objective: 把能送電與符合介面要求分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate power delivery from interface compliance.
steps.instruction: 列頻率、電壓、功率與諧波四項；為每項選觀測方式；加入一個虛構擾動並記錄恢復行為。
steps.instructionEn: List frequency, voltage, power and harmonics; assign observations; introduce a fictional disturbance and record recovery behavior.
steps.observation: 瞬間有功輸出不代表所有電網要求已滿足。
steps.observationEn: Instantaneous real-power output does not establish all grid requirements.
steps.failure: 只看發電量而不看介面條件會漏驗。
steps.failureEn: Energy-only checks miss interface conditions.
steps.check: 每項主張都有量測條件及未決事項。
steps.checkEn: Each claim has measurement conditions and open issues.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 電網介面涉及動態與波形品質，不只是平均功率。
knowledge.textEn: Grid interfaces involve dynamics and waveform quality, not average power alone.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 適用要求與測試須以具體電網規範為準，本課未代替併網審查。
knowledge.textEn: Applicable requirements depend on the specific grid code; this course does not replace interconnection review.

quiz.question: 針對「建立併網與電能品質問題單」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Build grid-interface and power-quality questions’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 發電量大即可忽略波形
任何電壓可直接接任何電網
併網需多項條件共同驗證
optionsEn: High energy output makes waveform irrelevant
Any voltage can connect directly to any grid
Verify multiple grid-interface conditions
quiz.explanation: 電網介面涉及動態與波形品質，不只是平均功率。 適用要求與測試須以具體電網規範為準，本課未代替併網審查。
quiz.explanationEn: Grid interfaces involve dynamics and waveform quality, not average power alone. Applicable requirements depend on the specific grid code; this course does not replace interconnection review.

stages.title: 安裝、運維與全生命週期
stages.description: 以資源、天候、量測與環境證據完成整合。
stages.descriptionEn: Integrate resources, weather, measurement and environmental evidence.
stages.route: 先完成前置學習，再提交圖解、推理與檢核證據；每一步均為原創教育任務。
stages.routeEn: Complete the prerequisites, then submit diagrams, reasoning and review evidence; each step is an original educational exercise.

steps.title: 規劃港口與安裝資源相依
steps.objective: 將大型零件物流與工序連結。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect large-component logistics to work dependencies.
steps.instruction: 列葉片、塔段與機艙三類物流；畫港口暫存及船舶時程；加入一項延誤並重排依賴。
steps.instructionEn: List blade, tower and nacelle logistics; draw port storage and vessel schedules; insert a delay and revise dependencies.
steps.observation: 進料節奏與海上資源需要同步。
steps.observationEn: Delivery rhythm must match offshore resources.
steps.failure: 假設所有大型件可無限暫存會失真。
steps.failureEn: Assuming unlimited storage distorts the plan.
steps.check: 排程標容量限制及關鍵等待點。
steps.checkEn: Mark capacity limits and critical waits.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 海上建造是物流、氣候與專用資源共同約束的系統。
knowledge.textEn: Offshore construction is constrained by logistics, weather and specialized resources.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 大型零件的存放方向、尺寸與交接順序會限制可用場地；物流資料需要和工序版本一致。
knowledge.textEn: Component orientation, size and handoff order constrain space; logistics information must match the work-sequence version.

quiz.question: 針對「規劃港口與安裝資源相依」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Plan port and installation dependencies’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 應同時管理暫存與船期
零件到港即等於可立即安裝
專用船永遠不會成為瓶頸
optionsEn: Manage storage and vessel timing together
Port arrival guarantees immediate installation
Specialized vessels never constrain progress
quiz.explanation: 海上建造是物流、氣候與專用資源共同約束的系統。 大型零件的存放方向、尺寸與交接順序會限制可用場地；物流資料需要和工序版本一致。
quiz.explanationEn: Offshore construction is constrained by logistics, weather and specialized resources. Component orientation, size and handoff order constrain space; logistics information must match the work-sequence version.

steps.title: 比較天候窗口與延誤風險
steps.titleEn: Compare weather windows and delay risk
steps.objective: 避免把平均天氣當連續可作業時段。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid treating average weather as continuous availability.
steps.instruction: 建一串可用與不可用的假想日曆；插入需連續數日的教學活動；比較相同可用天數但不同排列的日曆。
steps.instructionEn: Build hypothetical available/unavailable calendars; insert an activity needing consecutive days; compare equal availability with different ordering.
steps.observation: 可用天數相同不保證可完成同一工序。
steps.observationEn: Equal available days may not complete the same task.
steps.failure: 只用年度平均值安排連續活動會低估等待。
steps.failureEn: Annual averages can underestimate waiting for continuous tasks.
steps.check: 指出至少一個連續窗口不足的情況。
steps.checkEn: Identify a case with insufficient continuous window.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 天候風險依活動持續時間與限制條件變化，不是單一百分比。
knowledge.textEn: Weather risk depends on activity duration and constraints, not one percentage.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 預報不確定度會隨時間與情境改變；排程宜保留備選序列，並區分平均延誤與尾端風險。
knowledge.textEn: Forecast uncertainty varies with horizon and conditions; schedules need alternatives and should distinguish mean delay from tail risk.

quiz.question: 針對「比較天候窗口與延誤風險」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Compare weather windows and delay risk’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 任何活動使用相同天候條件
應分析連續可用窗口
全年有一半好天就隨時可作業
optionsEn: Every activity has identical weather limits
Analyze continuous usable windows
Half-year good weather permits work anytime
quiz.explanation: 天候風險依活動持續時間與限制條件變化，不是單一百分比。 預報不確定度會隨時間與情境改變；排程宜保留備選序列，並區分平均延誤與尾端風險。
quiz.explanationEn: Weather risk depends on activity duration and constraints, not one percentage. Forecast uncertainty varies with horizon and conditions; schedules need alternatives and should distinguish mean delay from tail risk.

steps.title: 解讀 SCADA 與狀態監測
steps.objective: 把異常訊號連到工況與校準。
steps.objectiveEn: Relate anomalies to operating conditions and calibration.
steps.instruction: 建立風速、功率與振動三條假想曲線；標停機與量測缺漏；提出感測器問題與設備問題兩種解釋。
steps.instructionEn: Create synthetic wind, power and vibration curves; mark stops and missing readings; propose sensor and equipment explanations.
steps.observation: 資料异常不一定等於設備故障。
steps.observationEn: An anomalous reading is not necessarily a machine fault.
steps.failure: 只依一點尖峰判定更換零件不可靠。
steps.failureEn: One spike cannot reliably justify component replacement.
steps.check: 至少用兩個相互獨立線索支持判斷。
steps.checkEn: Support interpretation with two independent clues.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 狀態監測需要基準、趨勢與工況正規化，不能只靠顏色燈號。
knowledge.textEn: Monitoring needs baselines, trends and operating normalization, not just colored indicators.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 多個感測器若共享處理程式或電源，其錯誤可能相關；判讀需檢查證據的獨立程度。
knowledge.textEn: Sensors sharing processing or power may have correlated errors; interpretation needs to examine evidence independence.

quiz.question: 針對「解讀 SCADA 與狀態監測」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Interpret SCADA and condition monitoring’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 紅色尖峰必然代表軸承損壞
缺資料應直接補成零發電
先排除資料與工況差異
optionsEn: A red spike necessarily proves bearing damage
Missing readings should always become zero power
First review data quality and operating differences
quiz.explanation: 狀態監測需要基準、趨勢與工況正規化，不能只靠顏色燈號。 多個感測器若共享處理程式或電源，其錯誤可能相關；判讀需檢查證據的獨立程度。
quiz.explanationEn: Monitoring needs baselines, trends and operating normalization, not just colored indicators. Sensors sharing processing or power may have correlated errors; interpretation needs to examine evidence independence.

steps.title: 估算可維護性與備件影響
steps.objective: 分清故障率與修復等待。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate failures from restoration delay.
steps.instruction: 假設同樣故障但不同備件等待時間；畫停機時間組成；比較基地、船期與替換件對可用率的影響。
steps.instructionEn: Assume equal faults with different spare delays; break downtime into components; compare base, vessel and replacement effects.
steps.observation: 修復時間包含等待，不只是工具作業。
steps.observationEn: Restoration time includes waiting, not just hands-on repair.
steps.failure: 只記實際維修工時會低估停機。
steps.failureEn: Hands-on hours alone underestimate downtime.
steps.check: 表格含偵測、等待、移動、修復與確認。
steps.checkEn: Include detection, waiting, travel, repair and verification.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 可維護性是設計、接近性、資源與證據交接共同結果。
knowledge.textEn: Maintainability combines design, access, resources and evidence handoff.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 備件數量與成本的最適化依故障模型，不能由單次案例推廣全風場。
knowledge.textEn: Spare optimization depends on failure models; one case cannot represent the whole farm.

quiz.question: 針對「估算可維護性與備件影響」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Estimate maintainability and spare effects’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 停機應包含物流與驗證時間
維修扳手使用時間就是全部停機
任何備件永遠越多越好
optionsEn: Downtime includes logistics and verification
Tool time equals total downtime
More of every spare is always optimal
quiz.explanation: 可維護性是設計、接近性、資源與證據交接共同結果。 備件數量與成本的最適化依故障模型，不能由單次案例推廣全風場。
quiz.explanationEn: Maintainability combines design, access, resources and evidence handoff. Spare optimization depends on failure models; one case cannot represent the whole farm.

steps.title: 把環境監測納入生命週期
steps.objective: 區分施工影響、營運影響與監測證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate construction, operational impacts and evidence.
steps.instruction: 列噪音、棲地與海床擾動三項問題；為各項分配前後期觀察；寫出自然變動可能造成的混淆。
steps.instructionEn: List noise, habitat and seabed-disturbance questions; assign before/after observations; identify confounding natural variation.
steps.observation: 清潔能源目標不等於沒有局部影響。
steps.observationEn: Clean-energy aims do not imply zero local impact.
steps.failure: 只觀察施工後而沒有基準會難以歸因。
steps.failureEn: Post-construction observation without a baseline weakens attribution.
steps.check: 至少列一個基準、一個對照與一個限制。
steps.checkEn: Identify a baseline, comparison and limitation.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 環境評估需要時空尺度與因果設計，單張照片不能代表生態狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Environmental assessment needs spatial/temporal scales and causal design; one photo cannot represent ecological state.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 季節變化可能同時影響處理區與對照區；保留跨時期與跨位置資料能協助分辨工程影響。
knowledge.textEn: Seasonal variation can affect both project and comparison areas; time and location coverage helps distinguish project effects.

quiz.question: 針對「把環境監測納入生命週期」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Include environmental monitoring in lifecycle’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 一張照片足以代表整片海域
監測應保留施工前基準與限制
再生能源項目絕無環境影響
optionsEn: One photograph represents an entire sea area
Preserve pre-construction baselines and limits
Renewable projects have no environmental impacts
quiz.explanation: 環境評估需要時空尺度與因果設計，單張照片不能代表生態狀態。 季節變化可能同時影響處理區與對照區；保留跨時期與跨位置資料能協助分辨工程影響。
quiz.explanationEn: Environmental assessment needs spatial/temporal scales and causal design; one photo cannot represent ecological state. Seasonal variation can affect both project and comparison areas; time and location coverage helps distinguish project effects.

steps.title: 完成風電—電網整合審查
steps.objective: 把機械、電氣與營運證據合在一起。
steps.objectiveEn: Combine mechanical, electrical and operational evidence.
steps.instruction: 彙整載荷路徑、集電圖與停機預算；找出跨領域矛盾；比較變壓器與伊泰普課程的共同電網介面及不同能源輸入。
steps.instructionEn: Gather load paths, collection topology and downtime budgets; find cross-domain conflicts; compare transformer and Itaipu courses for shared grid interfaces and different inputs.
steps.observation: 同為發電工程，資源與動態條件仍不同。
steps.observationEn: Generating projects still differ in resources and dynamics.
steps.failure: 直接把水電調度概念套到風電會忽略可控制程度。
steps.failureEn: Transferring hydropower dispatch directly to wind ignores controllability differences.
steps.check: 提交含相似處、差異、未決項與來源日期的審查。
steps.checkEn: Submit similarities, differences, open issues and source dates.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 大型能源工程共用功率平衡、設備可靠度與電網介面，但水、風與儲能的控制自由度不同。
knowledge.textEn: Energy projects share balance, reliability and grid interfaces, but water, wind and storage offer different control freedoms.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 能源輸入的可控制程度會影響調度與備援策略；比較不同電廠時要將儲能、資源和電網條件分列。
knowledge.textEn: Input controllability affects dispatch and backup strategies; separate storage, resource and grid conditions when comparing plants.

quiz.question: 針對「完成風電—電網整合審查」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Complete a wind–grid integration review’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 所有發電廠可用完全相同控制
設計容量越大就完全不需要電網審查
比較時保留不同能源的控制限制
optionsEn: All plants use identical control
Larger capacity eliminates grid review
Preserve source-specific control limits when comparing
quiz.explanation: 大型能源工程共用功率平衡、設備可靠度與電網介面，但水、風與儲能的控制自由度不同。 能源輸入的可控制程度會影響調度與備援策略；比較不同電廠時要將儲能、資源和電網條件分列。
quiz.explanationEn: Energy projects share balance, reliability and grid interfaces, but water, wind and storage offer different control freedoms. Input controllability affects dispatch and backup strategies; separate storage, resource and grid conditions when comparing plants.

courses.title: EXPLORER 全身正子影像系統
courses.summary: 以二十四步拆解光子偵測、符合事件、時間同步、校正、重建與研究品質證據。
courses.summaryEn: Twenty-four steps examine photon detection, coincidences, synchronization, correction, reconstruction and research-quality evidence.
courses.scope: 僅以虛構事件表與非人體教學影像學習醫學影像工程，不提供病人診斷、放射性藥物製備、注射量、掃描處方或設備操作。實際醫療由合格專業人員執行。
courses.scopeEn: Learn imaging engineering with synthetic event tables and non-patient teaching images only. No diagnosis, radiopharmaceutical preparation, administered activity, scan prescription or equipment operation is provided; real care requires qualified professionals.

stages.title: 成像物理與系統分界
stages.description: 從觀測量區分 PET、CT 與全身視野。
stages.descriptionEn: Distinguish PET, CT and total-body coverage by observables.
stages.route: 先完成前置學習，再提交圖解、推理與檢核證據；每一步均為原創教育任務。
stages.routeEn: Complete the prerequisites, then submit diagrams, reasoning and review evidence; each step is an original educational exercise.

steps.title: 界定 PET 與 CT 的不同觀測
steps.titleEn: Define different PET and CT observables
steps.objective: 避免把功能影像與結構影像混為一談。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid conflating functional and structural imaging.
steps.instruction: 畫 PET 訊號來源與 CT 外部照射兩條概念鏈；列出各自量測量；標出影像融合仍需的座標資訊。
steps.instructionEn: Draw conceptual PET-emission and external CT-illumination chains; list their measurements; identify coordinate data needed for fusion.
steps.observation: 相同外形的設備可能包含不同成像原理。
steps.observationEn: One enclosure may contain different imaging principles.
steps.failure: 把 PET 視為另一台普通照相機會誤解。
steps.failureEn: Treating PET as an ordinary camera misleads.
steps.check: 表格分列訊號來源、量測與輸出用途。
steps.checkEn: Separate source, measurement and output role.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: PET 偵測體內放射性示蹤訊號的分布；CT 量測 X 光穿透相關資訊，原理不同。
knowledge.textEn: PET detects distributions of radiotracer emissions; CT measures X-ray transmission-related information.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 融合影像須保留各模態的單位與物理意義；幾何重疊不會把發射與穿透測量變成同一種量。
knowledge.textEn: Fused images must retain modality-specific units and meaning; spatial overlap does not make emission and transmission identical measurements.

quiz.question: 針對「界定 PET 與 CT 的不同觀測」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Define different PET and CT observables’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 兩種影像需依各自物理量解釋
PET 與 CT 完全同一物理量
顏色亮就能直接判定疾病
optionsEn: Interpret each modality through its own measured quantity
PET and CT measure an identical quantity
Bright colors directly diagnose disease
quiz.explanation: PET 偵測體內放射性示蹤訊號的分布；CT 量測 X 光穿透相關資訊，原理不同。 融合影像須保留各模態的單位與物理意義；幾何重疊不會把發射與穿透測量變成同一種量。
quiz.explanationEn: PET detects distributions of radiotracer emissions; CT measures X-ray transmission-related information. Fused images must retain modality-specific units and meaning; spatial overlap does not make emission and transmission identical measurements.

steps.title: 建立正子湮滅的簡化幾何
steps.objective: 理解光子對與量測事件的關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand photon pairs and measured events.
steps.instruction: 在虛構圓環中央放一個事件點；畫兩個近反向光子；標示源位置、湮滅點與偵測點並說明簡化。
steps.instructionEn: Place a synthetic event inside a ring; draw near-opposite photons; label origin, annihilation and detections and explain the simplification.
steps.observation: 偵測點不是放射源本身的位置。
steps.observationEn: Detection points are not source positions.
steps.failure: 把每次事件看成精準無誤差直線會過度理想化。
steps.failureEn: Treating every event as an exact line overidealizes.
steps.check: 區分示蹤源、湮滅事件與探測器。
steps.checkEn: Distinguish tracer origin, annihilation and detector.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 正子行程與光子非完全共線性等物理因素會限制定位。
knowledge.textEn: Positron range and photon non-collinearity contribute localization limits.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 兩個光子都被偵測到才形成可用配對的候選事件；接受角度與材料效率會限制幾何理想值。
knowledge.textEn: Detecting both photons creates a candidate pair; acceptance angles and material efficiency limit ideal geometric performance.

quiz.question: 針對「建立正子湮滅的簡化幾何」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Build simplified annihilation geometry’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 幾何直線可消除所有物理不確定度
需分清事件發生處與被偵測處
兩個光子必然在探測器內才產生
optionsEn: A geometric line removes all physical uncertainty
Separate event origin from detection
Both photons necessarily originate inside detectors
quiz.explanation: 正子行程與光子非完全共線性等物理因素會限制定位。 兩個光子都被偵測到才形成可用配對的候選事件；接受角度與材料效率會限制幾何理想值。
quiz.explanationEn: Positron range and photon non-collinearity contribute localization limits. Detecting both photons creates a candidate pair; acceptance angles and material efficiency limit ideal geometric performance.

steps.title: 由符合對建立響應線
steps.titleEn: Build lines of response from coincidences
steps.objective: 了解一筆事件不等於一個完整像素。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand that one event is not a complete image pixel.
steps.instruction: 在八個虛構偵測位置中配對；連接符合對成直線；疊加多條線並標出資訊仍不足的地方。
steps.instructionEn: Pair eight hypothetical detector positions; join coincidences with lines; overlay many lines and mark remaining ambiguity.
steps.observation: 多事件統計才支持空間分布估計。
steps.observationEn: Many events support distribution estimation.
steps.failure: 把一條響應線的中點當必然源位置不正確。
steps.failureEn: A response-line midpoint is not necessarily the source location.
steps.check: 能說明為何需更多方向與事件。
steps.checkEn: Explain the need for more directions and events.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 不使用時間資訊時，符合對主要約束一條響應線附近，而不是唯一位置。
knowledge.textEn: Without timing information, a coincidence constrains a region near a response line rather than one point.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 響應線受偵測器尺寸、散射與幾何模型影響。
knowledge.textEn: Detector size, scattering and geometry affect response lines.

quiz.question: 針對「由符合對建立響應線」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Build lines of response from coincidences’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 中點必定就是來源
單一事件就能生成完整全身影像
一對偵測主要提供線上位置約束
optionsEn: The midpoint is always the origin
One event produces a complete total-body image
A pair mainly supplies a line-location constraint
quiz.explanation: 不使用時間資訊時，符合對主要約束一條響應線附近，而不是唯一位置。 響應線受偵測器尺寸、散射與幾何模型影響。
quiz.explanationEn: Without timing information, a coincidence constrains a region near a response line rather than one point. Detector size, scattering and geometry affect response lines.

steps.title: 比較短軸向與長軸向視野
steps.titleEn: Compare short and long axial coverage
steps.objective: 理解幾何涵蓋與同時觀測。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand geometry coverage and simultaneous observation.
steps.instruction: 畫短圓環與長圓筒偵測範圍；把三個教學物件放在不同軸向位置；比較分段觀測與同時觀測的時間差。
steps.instructionEn: Draw short-ring and long-cylinder coverage; place three teaching objects at different axial positions; compare sequential and simultaneous observations.
steps.observation: 長視野可同時涵蓋更多位置。
steps.observationEn: A long field can observe more locations simultaneously.
steps.failure: 增加長度不代表所有情況同倍率改善。
steps.failureEn: More length does not guarantee the same gain in every case.
steps.check: 比較表分列幾何涵蓋、時間與偵測效率。
steps.checkEn: Separate coverage, timing and detection efficiency.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: uEXPLORER 原始研究描述約 194 cm 軸向視野；改善幅度仍依任務與測試條件而定。
knowledge.textEn: Original uEXPLORER research reports about 194 cm axial coverage; benefit depends on task and test conditions.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 全身同時觀測與多床位依序拼接具有不同時間資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Simultaneous total-body observation and sequential bed-position assembly contain different timing information.

quiz.question: 針對「比較短軸向與長軸向視野」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Compare short and long axial coverage’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 應比較空間與時間涵蓋
長一倍就必然所有性能都兩倍
全身影像一定全在同一時刻量到
optionsEn: Compare spatial and temporal coverage
Doubling length doubles every performance metric
Any whole-body image was measured simultaneously
quiz.explanation: uEXPLORER 原始研究描述約 194 cm 軸向視野；改善幅度仍依任務與測試條件而定。 全身同時觀測與多床位依序拼接具有不同時間資訊。
quiz.explanationEn: Original uEXPLORER research reports about 194 cm axial coverage; benefit depends on task and test conditions. Simultaneous total-body observation and sequential bed-position assembly contain different timing information.

steps.title: 分開靈敏度、解析度與雜訊
steps.objective: 建立多指標評估而非單一排名。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate multiple metrics rather than one ranking.
steps.instruction: 列三個指標並各寫量測問題；在兩個虛構系統間比較；找出某一指標改善但另一指標不變的情況。
steps.instructionEn: List three metrics and their measurement questions; compare hypothetical systems; find a case where one improves while another does not.
steps.observation: 偵測更多事件不必然讓點擴散更窄。
steps.observationEn: More detected events do not necessarily narrow spatial response.
steps.failure: 把靈敏度倍數當成解析度倍數是錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Sensitivity gains are not resolution gains.
steps.check: 每個指標附定義、條件與單位。
steps.checkEn: Attach definition, conditions and units to every metric.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 靈敏度描述偵測能力，解析度描述空間分辨，雜訊描述隨機變異。
knowledge.textEn: Sensitivity concerns detection, resolution spatial separation and noise random variability.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 不同研究若使用不同幾何或重建設定，數值不可不加說明地直接排名。
knowledge.textEn: Results with different geometry or reconstruction settings cannot be ranked without qualification.

quiz.question: 針對「分開靈敏度、解析度與雜訊」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Separate sensitivity, resolution and noise’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 無單位百分比可代表所有品質
應同時評估三個不同指標
最高靈敏度必定最高解析度
optionsEn: One unitless percentage represents all quality
Assess the three distinct metrics together
Highest sensitivity guarantees highest resolution
quiz.explanation: 靈敏度描述偵測能力，解析度描述空間分辨，雜訊描述隨機變異。 不同研究若使用不同幾何或重建設定，數值不可不加說明地直接排名。
quiz.explanationEn: Sensitivity concerns detection, resolution spatial separation and noise random variability. Results with different geometry or reconstruction settings cannot be ranked without qualification.

steps.title: 繪製成像系統介面
steps.objective: 區分物理偵測、計算與研究輸出。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate detection, computation and research output.
steps.instruction: 畫探測器、計時、事件表、重建四節點；標資料型態；替每條介面寫來源、版本與時間要求。
steps.instructionEn: Draw detector, timing, event-table and reconstruction nodes; label data types; state origin, version and time requirements for each interface.
steps.observation: 影像品質依整條資料鏈而定。
steps.observationEn: Image quality depends on the full data chain.
steps.failure: 只檢查最終影像外觀會漏掉資料遺失。
steps.failureEn: Final-image appearance may hide data loss.
steps.check: 所有箭頭都寫清輸入、輸出及責任。
steps.checkEn: Label input, output and responsibility on every arrow.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 大量探測事件需一致的幾何、時基與校準，才能整合為可解釋資料。
knowledge.textEn: Many detector events need consistent geometry, timing and calibration to become interpretable data.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 幾何表和校準表是事件解讀的一部分；只保存數字而不保存通道定義，日後可能無法正確重建。
knowledge.textEn: Geometry and calibration tables are part of event interpretation; numbers without channel definitions may become unreconstructable.

quiz.question: 針對「繪製成像系統介面」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Draw the imaging-system interfaces’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 只要終圖好看資料必定完整
廠商名稱相同即代表所有版本等效
整條鏈都需可追溯的介面資料
optionsEn: An attractive final image proves complete data
A shared vendor name proves all versions equivalent
Make interfaces traceable throughout the chain
quiz.explanation: 大量探測事件需一致的幾何、時基與校準，才能整合為可解釋資料。 幾何表和校準表是事件解讀的一部分；只保存數字而不保存通道定義，日後可能無法正確重建。
quiz.explanationEn: Many detector events need consistent geometry, timing and calibration to become interpretable data. Geometry and calibration tables are part of event interpretation; numbers without channel definitions may become unreconstructable.

stages.title: 偵測器與資料擷取
stages.description: 把閃爍訊號轉成可追蹤的數位事件。
stages.descriptionEn: Turn scintillation signals into traceable digital events.
stages.route: 先完成前置學習，再提交圖解、推理與檢核證據；每一步均為原創教育任務。
stages.routeEn: Complete the prerequisites, then submit diagrams, reasoning and review evidence; each step is an original educational exercise.

steps.title: 拆解閃爍體到光電訊號
steps.objective: 理解能量轉換與波形觀測。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand energy conversion and waveform observation.
steps.instruction: 畫光子、閃爍光與光感測器三級；配一條虛構脈衝；標幅度、到達時間與雜訊基線。
steps.instructionEn: Draw photon, scintillation light and photosensor stages; add a synthetic pulse; label amplitude, arrival and noise baseline.
steps.observation: 同一脈衝包含多種估計資訊。
steps.observationEn: One pulse supports several estimates.
steps.failure: 把脈衝高度直接當來源位置不成立。
steps.failureEn: Pulse height does not directly locate the source.
steps.check: 在波形上分開時間與能量代理量。
steps.checkEn: Separate timing and energy proxies on the waveform.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 閃爍晶體與感測器將能量沉積轉為電訊號，轉換本身有統計變異。
knowledge.textEn: Scintillator and sensor convert energy deposition to electrical signals with statistical variation.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 光的收集效率與感測器增益都影響脈衝統計，能量解析與時間解析因此需要分別量測。
knowledge.textEn: Light-collection efficiency and sensor gain affect pulse statistics, so energy and timing resolution need separate measurement.

quiz.question: 針對「拆解閃爍體到光電訊號」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Decompose scintillation-to-electrical conversion’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 幅度與時間需分開估計
波形高度就是空間座標
能量轉換完全沒有雜訊
optionsEn: Estimate amplitude and time separately
Waveform height is a spatial coordinate
Energy conversion has no noise
quiz.explanation: 閃爍晶體與感測器將能量沉積轉為電訊號，轉換本身有統計變異。 光的收集效率與感測器增益都影響脈衝統計，能量解析與時間解析因此需要分別量測。
quiz.explanationEn: Scintillator and sensor convert energy deposition to electrical signals with statistical variation. Light-collection efficiency and sensor gain affect pulse statistics, so energy and timing resolution need separate measurement.

steps.title: 檢查通道增益與能量標定
steps.titleEn: Check channel gain and energy calibration
steps.objective: 避免把通道差異當物理差異。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid mistaking channel variation for physics.
steps.instruction: 給三個虛構通道相同輸入；記錄不同輸出幅度；建立相對校準並保留校準前後圖。
steps.instructionEn: Give three synthetic channels the same input; record differing amplitudes; form a relative calibration and keep before/after plots.
steps.observation: 等能量事件可能產生不同數位幅度。
steps.observationEn: Equal-energy events may yield different digital amplitudes.
steps.failure: 直接比較未校準通道會形成系統偏差。
steps.failureEn: Comparing uncalibrated channels creates systematic bias.
steps.check: 每個校準係數附通道與版本。
steps.checkEn: Attach channel identity and version to coefficients.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 增益校準建立可比性；校準仍有漂移與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Gain calibration establishes comparability but still has drift and uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 溫度或電子學狀態改變可能讓通道增益漂移；校準的有效期間需以穩定性資料支持。
knowledge.textEn: Temperature or electronics changes can shift gain; calibration validity periods need stability evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「檢查通道增益與能量標定」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Check channel gain and energy calibration’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 校準一次即可永遠不變
相同輸入應以校準後量比較
通道原始數字必然可直接比較
optionsEn: One calibration lasts unchanged forever
Compare calibrated values for equal inputs
Raw channel numbers are always directly comparable
quiz.explanation: 增益校準建立可比性；校準仍有漂移與不確定度。 溫度或電子學狀態改變可能讓通道增益漂移；校準的有效期間需以穩定性資料支持。
quiz.explanationEn: Gain calibration establishes comparability but still has drift and uncertainty. Temperature or electronics changes can shift gain; calibration validity periods need stability evidence.

steps.title: 辨識時間偏移與時鐘漂移
steps.titleEn: Identify timing offsets and clock drift
steps.objective: 區分固定差值與逐漸變化。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish constant offsets from changing drift.
steps.instruction: 建立兩條虛構時間戳序列；先加入固定差值再加入斜率差；用圖分辨兩種誤差並提出校正證據。
steps.instructionEn: Create two synthetic timestamp streams; add an offset then a slope difference; distinguish them graphically and propose calibration evidence.
steps.observation: 對齊一次不保證長時間同步。
steps.observationEn: One alignment does not ensure lasting synchronization.
steps.failure: 把所有時間差都當固定偏移會留下殘差。
steps.failureEn: Treating all timing error as fixed offset leaves residuals.
steps.check: 報告同時列偏移、漂移及觀測區間。
steps.checkEn: Report offset, drift and observation duration.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 時間同步影響符合配對與飛行時間定位，不只是檔案排序。
knowledge.textEn: Timing affects coincidence pairing and time-of-flight localization, not just sorting.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 時間戳的單位、解析度與共同時基必須一致；增加儲存位數不能修正不同時鐘的物理偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Timestamp units, resolution and timebase must agree; more stored digits do not correct physical clock differences.

quiz.question: 針對「辨識時間偏移與時鐘漂移」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Identify timing offsets and clock drift’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 一次零點重設能永久消除漂移
時間戳與成像位置無關
需分別評估偏移與漂移
optionsEn: One reset permanently removes drift
Timestamps cannot affect image localization
Assess offset and drift separately
quiz.explanation: 時間同步影響符合配對與飛行時間定位，不只是檔案排序。 時間戳的單位、解析度與共同時基必須一致；增加儲存位數不能修正不同時鐘的物理偏差。
quiz.explanationEn: Timing affects coincidence pairing and time-of-flight localization, not just sorting. Timestamp units, resolution and timebase must agree; more stored digits do not correct physical clock differences.

steps.title: 建立符合事件的判別表
steps.objective: 理解配對条件與誤配問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand pairing criteria and false pairings.
steps.instruction: 產生帶通道與時間的虛構事件表；用任意教學窗口配對；比較窗口變寬後真配對與誤配對可能變化。
steps.instructionEn: Generate synthetic channel/time events; pair them using an arbitrary teaching window; compare possible true and false pairing changes when it widens.
steps.observation: 接受更多事件也可能接受更多誤配。
steps.observationEn: Accepting more events may admit more false pairs.
steps.failure: 窗口越大影像一定越好不成立。
steps.failureEn: A wider window does not guarantee better images.
steps.check: 明確標出窗口只作教學且非設備設定。
steps.checkEn: Label the window as a teaching value, not an equipment setting.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 符合條件需要時間與幾何相容；偶然同時事件也可能被誤配。
knowledge.textEn: Coincidences need temporal and geometric compatibility; unrelated events can pair accidentally.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 最佳參數依系統與測試任務，本課不提供臨床取得條件。
knowledge.textEn: Appropriate parameters depend on system and task; no clinical acquisition conditions are supplied.

quiz.question: 針對「建立符合事件的判別表」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Build a coincidence classification table’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 應權衡保留事件與誤配
越寬窗口永遠越準
只要時間接近必然同一事件
optionsEn: Balance retained events against false pairs
Wider windows are always more accurate
Nearby times guarantee one physical event
quiz.explanation: 符合條件需要時間與幾何相容；偶然同時事件也可能被誤配。 最佳參數依系統與測試任務，本課不提供臨床取得條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Coincidences need temporal and geometric compatibility; unrelated events can pair accidentally. Appropriate parameters depend on system and task; no clinical acquisition conditions are supplied.

steps.title: 把時間差換成位置區間
steps.titleEn: Relate time difference to a position interval
steps.objective: 理解 TOF 提供的是有限精度約束。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand TOF as a finite-precision constraint.
steps.instruction: 畫一條響應線與兩端探測器；標時間差正負；以 Δx=cΔt/2 的理想式畫出含不確定度的位置區間。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a response line with two detectors; label time-difference sign; use ideal Δx=cΔt/2 to mark a location interval with uncertainty.
steps.observation: 時間解析度有限，所以位置是區間而非無誤差點。
steps.observationEn: Finite timing resolution gives an interval, not an exact point.
steps.failure: 把一個 TOF 事件當精準像素會過度解讀。
steps.failureEn: Treating one TOF event as an exact pixel overinterprets it.
steps.check: 公式中的秒、米與二分之一都有說明。
steps.checkEn: Explain seconds, meters and the factor of two.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 兩光子的路徑差隨事件位置變化兩倍，因此理想位置差含二分之一。
knowledge.textEn: The difference of the two path lengths changes twice as fast as position, giving the factor one-half.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 真實 TOF 還有校準、探測器和統計效應，這不是診斷定位計算器。
knowledge.textEn: Real TOF includes calibration, detector and statistical effects; this is not a diagnostic locator.

quiz.question: 針對「把時間差換成位置區間」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Relate time difference to a position interval’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 位置差必定等於 cΔt 而沒有除二
應報告位置區間與時間不確定度
飛行時間完全消除所有模糊
optionsEn: Position difference is always cΔt without halving
Report a location interval and timing uncertainty
TOF eliminates all blur
quiz.explanation: 兩光子的路徑差隨事件位置變化兩倍，因此理想位置差含二分之一。 真實 TOF 還有校準、探測器和統計效應，這不是診斷定位計算器。
quiz.explanationEn: The difference of the two path lengths changes twice as fast as position, giving the factor one-half. Real TOF includes calibration, detector and statistical effects; this is not a diagnostic locator.

steps.title: 評估事件吞吐與遺失
steps.objective: 把資料量與可追蹤完整性連結。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect data volume to traceable completeness.
steps.instruction: 建立假想每秒事件量；乘上每筆資料大小估算流量；加入緩衝溢出事件並比較輸入與輸出計數。
steps.instructionEn: Set synthetic events per second; multiply by record size for data rate; add buffer overflow and compare input/output counts.
steps.observation: 高靈敏度也增加資料處理需求。
steps.observationEn: High sensitivity also increases processing demand.
steps.failure: 檔案可打開不代表事件完全保留。
steps.failureEn: A readable file does not prove complete events.
steps.check: 保留丟棄計數、序號與時間區段。
steps.checkEn: Keep dropped counts, sequence numbers and time intervals.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 吞吐瓶頸可能位於電子學、網路或儲存；必須沿全鏈檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Bottlenecks can lie in electronics, networking or storage and need end-to-end checks.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 資料缺失若與事件率相關，可能引入非隨機偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Loss correlated with event rate can introduce nonrandom bias.

quiz.question: 針對「評估事件吞吐與遺失」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Assess event throughput and loss’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 儲存空間夠大就不會掉事件
遺失事件永遠都是無害的隨機樣本
需核對輸入輸出與丟失紀錄
optionsEn: Ample disk space guarantees no event loss
Lost events are always harmless random samples
Compare input, output and loss logs
quiz.explanation: 吞吐瓶頸可能位於電子學、網路或儲存；必須沿全鏈檢查。 資料缺失若與事件率相關，可能引入非隨機偏差。
quiz.explanationEn: Bottlenecks can lie in electronics, networking or storage and need end-to-end checks. Loss correlated with event rate can introduce nonrandom bias.

stages.title: 校正與影像重建
stages.description: 理解量測偏差、統計與重建模型。
stages.descriptionEn: Understand measurement bias, statistics and reconstruction models.
stages.route: 先完成前置學習，再提交圖解、推理與檢核證據；每一步均為原創教育任務。
stages.routeEn: Complete the prerequisites, then submit diagrams, reasoning and review evidence; each step is an original educational exercise.

steps.title: 理解衰減與 CT 對位
steps.objective: 分開光子損失與位置對應。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate photon loss from spatial registration.
steps.instruction: 畫均勻教學物件中的兩條不同長度路徑；標相對穿透差；把衰減圖平移一格，觀察校正套錯位置的問題。
steps.instructionEn: Draw two path lengths through a uniform teaching object; mark transmission differences; shift an attenuation map one cell and inspect misapplied correction.
steps.observation: 同一發射強度可能因路徑而有不同偵測量。
steps.observationEn: Equal emission can yield different detections because of path length.
steps.failure: 把衰減差異直接解讀為生理差異不合適。
steps.failureEn: Attenuation differences should not directly become physiological interpretations.
steps.check: 分列衰減模型與影像對位兩種誤差。
steps.checkEn: Separate attenuation-model and registration errors.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: PET 校正需描述光子沿路徑的損失；CT 資訊的使用還需能量轉換與座標一致性。
knowledge.textEn: PET attenuation correction models path losses; using CT also needs energy conversion and coordinate consistency.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 衰減係數依光子能量與材料而變；影像座標一致仍不保證物理係數轉換正確，兩者需分別驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Attenuation depends on photon energy and material; aligned coordinates do not guarantee correct coefficient conversion, so both require verification.

quiz.question: 針對「理解衰減與 CT 對位」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Understand attenuation and CT registration’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 對位錯誤可能污染校正結果
衰減圖放任何位置都相同
CT 亮度直接等於 PET 放射強度
optionsEn: Misregistration can corrupt correction
Attenuation-map position never matters
CT brightness equals PET activity
quiz.explanation: PET 校正需描述光子沿路徑的損失；CT 資訊的使用還需能量轉換與座標一致性。 衰減係數依光子能量與材料而變；影像座標一致仍不保證物理係數轉換正確，兩者需分別驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: PET attenuation correction models path losses; using CT also needs energy conversion and coordinate consistency. Attenuation depends on photon energy and material; aligned coordinates do not guarantee correct coefficient conversion, so both require verification.

steps.title: 分開散射與隨機符合
steps.objective: 辨認不同污染來源需要不同模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Recognize different contamination mechanisms.
steps.instruction: 畫一個轉向光子案例；另畫兩個無關事件的誤配；在事件表分別標真、散射、隨機三類教學標籤。
steps.instructionEn: Draw one deflected photon case and one pairing from unrelated events; label true, scattered and random cases in a teaching table.
steps.observation: 錯誤配對與路徑改變不是同一機制。
steps.observationEn: False pairing and path deflection are different mechanisms.
steps.failure: 把所有背景用同一常數扣除可能失真。
steps.failureEn: Subtracting one constant for all backgrounds can distort data.
steps.check: 以圖解說明兩種污染的差別。
steps.checkEn: Explain both mechanisms with diagrams.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 散射改變光子能量和方向；隨機符合把無關光子當成一對。
knowledge.textEn: Scatter changes photon energy/direction; random coincidences pair unrelated photons.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 實際事件真值不可直接觀測，校正依統計模型與驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Real event truth is not directly observable; correction depends on statistical models and validation.

quiz.question: 針對「分開散射與隨機符合」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Separate scatter from random coincidences’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 散射事件一定能憑照片肉眼辨認
不同機制需各自校正與驗證
所有背景都是同一種噪聲常數
optionsEn: Scatter is always visually identifiable in a photograph
Different mechanisms need appropriate correction and validation
All background is one constant noise term
quiz.explanation: 散射改變光子能量和方向；隨機符合把無關光子當成一對。 實際事件真值不可直接觀測，校正依統計模型與驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: Scatter changes photon energy/direction; random coincidences pair unrelated photons. Real event truth is not directly observable; correction depends on statistical models and validation.

steps.title: 校準幾何響應與通道效率
steps.objective: 避免把探測器差異當物件差異。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid turning detector differences into object differences.
steps.instruction: 給均勻教學物件設定相同發射；讓某通道效率降低；比較未校正與校正後分布並標出殘差。
steps.instructionEn: Set uniform synthetic emission; reduce one channel’s efficiency; compare corrected and uncorrected distributions and mark residuals.
steps.observation: 假結構可能來自通道響應。
steps.observationEn: Apparent structure may come from channel response.
steps.failure: 一次校準不涵蓋所有配置與時間。
steps.failureEn: One calibration does not cover every configuration or time.
steps.check: 校準記錄含幾何版本、日期與測試條件。
steps.checkEn: Record geometry version, date and test conditions.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 正規化補償系統響應差異，需要與實際偵測器配置一致。
knowledge.textEn: Normalization compensates response differences and must match detector configuration.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 壞通道、漂移與缺資料須顯式處理，不能任意補成理想數值。
knowledge.textEn: Bad channels, drift and missing data need explicit treatment, not invented ideal values.

quiz.question: 針對「校準幾何響應與通道效率」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Normalize geometry and channel efficiency’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 均勻物件出現條紋一定是物件真實結構
更換通道後可無條件沿用校準
校準需對應幾何與通道狀態
optionsEn: Stripes in a uniform object must be real structure
Calibration always remains valid after replacing a channel
Match calibration to geometry and channel state
quiz.explanation: 正規化補償系統響應差異，需要與實際偵測器配置一致。 壞通道、漂移與缺資料須顯式處理，不能任意補成理想數值。
quiz.explanationEn: Normalization compensates response differences and must match detector configuration. Bad channels, drift and missing data need explicit treatment, not invented ideal values.

steps.title: 比較死時間與隨機雜訊
steps.titleEn: Compare dead time with random noise
steps.objective: 理解高事件率的非線性。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand high-rate nonlinearity.
steps.instruction: 畫理想輸入對輸出直線；加入假想飽和彎曲；比較兩段事件率下比例是否一致。
steps.instructionEn: Draw an ideal input/output line; add hypothetical saturation curvature; compare proportionality at two event rates.
steps.observation: 輸入增加不保證輸出等比例增加。
steps.observationEn: More input need not produce proportional output.
steps.failure: 把所有低計數都當低來源強度會誤判。
steps.failureEn: Low recorded counts need not mean low source strength.
steps.check: 報告明確分開事件率損失與統計波動。
steps.checkEn: Separate rate losses from statistical fluctuation.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 死時間是系統處理後暫時不能記錄另一事件的效應，可造成率相依損失。
knowledge.textEn: Dead time describes temporary inability to record another event, producing rate-dependent loss.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 率校正模型也帶入不確定度；接近飽和時，反推失去的事件資訊可能變得不穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Rate-correction models add uncertainty; near saturation, inferring lost events can become unstable.

quiz.question: 針對「比較死時間與隨機雜訊」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Compare dead time with random noise’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 應檢查計數響應是否仍近似線性
輸入加倍輸出必定加倍
可用任意更大輸入克服所有雜訊
optionsEn: Check whether count response remains approximately linear
Twice the input always means twice the output
Arbitrarily increasing input overcomes all noise
quiz.explanation: 死時間是系統處理後暫時不能記錄另一事件的效應，可造成率相依損失。 率校正模型也帶入不確定度；接近飽和時，反推失去的事件資訊可能變得不穩定。
quiz.explanationEn: Dead time describes temporary inability to record another event, producing rate-dependent loss. Rate-correction models add uncertainty; near saturation, inferring lost events can become unstable.

steps.title: 建立前向模型與迭代重建
steps.titleEn: Build a forward model and iterative reconstruction
steps.objective: 理解影像是由量測估計而來。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand images as estimates from measurements.
steps.instruction: 畫四格教學影像與幾條投影；由影像預測事件量；比較預測與虛構量測，再做一次非負更新並保存殘差。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a four-cell image and projections; predict event counts; compare with synthetic measurements, make one nonnegative update and keep residuals.
steps.observation: 可見影像取決於模型與量測共同作用。
steps.observationEn: The visible image depends on model and data together.
steps.failure: 迭代次數越多必然越真實不成立。
steps.failureEn: More iterations do not guarantee greater truth.
steps.check: 提交初值、預測、殘差及更新後結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit initialization, prediction, residual and updated result.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 前向模型把候選分布映到觀測，重建則用差異修正估計。
knowledge.textEn: A forward model maps candidate distributions to observations; reconstruction updates estimates using disagreement.

knowledge.title: 驗證與界限
knowledge.text: 正則化與停止條件改變偏差—雜訊權衡；四格例子非臨床演算法。
knowledge.textEn: Regularization and stopping affect bias–noise trade-offs; the four-cell example is not a clinical algorithm.

quiz.question: 針對「建立前向模型與迭代重建」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Build a forward model and iterative reconstruction’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 影像每一格都是直接拍到的真值
重建需同時檢查模型與殘差
更多迭代永遠等於更正確
optionsEn: Every voxel is directly photographed truth
Examine the model and residuals during reconstruction
More iterations are always more correct
quiz.explanation: 前向模型把候選分布映到觀測，重建則用差異修正估計。 正則化與停止條件改變偏差—雜訊權衡；四格例子非臨床演算法。
quiz.explanationEn: A forward model maps candidate distributions to observations; reconstruction updates estimates using disagreement. Regularization and stopping affect bias–noise trade-offs; the four-cell example is not a clinical algorithm.

steps.title: 設計動態影像的時間分箱
steps.titleEn: Design time framing for dynamic images
steps.objective: 比較時間解析與統計精度。
steps.objectiveEn: Compare temporal resolution with statistical precision.
steps.instruction: 把同一虛構事件流切為短框與長框；繪出兩種時間曲線；比較短框波動與長框平滑的代價。
steps.instructionEn: Split one synthetic stream into short and long frames; plot both curves; compare short-frame variation and long-frame smoothing costs.
steps.observation: 較短時間框可看快速變化但事件較少。
steps.observationEn: Shorter frames resolve change but contain fewer events.
steps.failure: 曲線越平滑就必然越真實不正確。
steps.failureEn: Smoother curves are not necessarily truer.
steps.check: 說明選框長度與研究問題的關係。
steps.checkEn: Explain frame duration relative to the research question.

knowledge.title: 工程原理
knowledge.text: 動態 PET 的優勢包含同時觀察多位置的時間變化；時間分箱仍影響可辨識特徵。
knowledge.textEn: Dynamic PET can observe multiple locations over time; framing affects detectable features.

knowledge.title: 模型與驗證
knowledge.text: 不同時間框的計數可能受同一校準偏差影響；時間曲線比較需區分隨機波動與共享的系統誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Frames may share calibration bias; time-curve comparisons must separate random fluctuation from shared systematic error.

quiz.question: 針對「設計動態影像的時間分箱」，哪個判斷正確？
quiz.questionEn: For ‘Design time framing for dynamic images’, which conclusion is justified?
options: 框越短所有性能都越好
平滑即可證明模型正確
框長度需權衡時間與統計
optionsEn: Shorter frames improve every metric
Smoothing proves model correctness
Frame duration trades timing against statistics
quiz.explanation: 動態 PET 的優勢包含同時觀察多位置的時間變化；時間分箱仍影響可辨識特徵。 不同時間框的計數可能受同一校準偏差影響；時間曲線比較需區分隨機波動與共享的系統誤差。
quiz.explanationEn: Dynamic PET can observe multiple locations over time; framing affects detectable features. Frames may share calibration bias; time-curve comparisons must separate random fluctuation from shared systematic error.

stages.title: 品質驗證與研究資料
stages.description: 用可重現的非臨床證據檢查成像系統。
stages.descriptionEn: Evaluate imaging systems using reproducible nonclinical evidence.
stages.route: 先完成前置學習，再提交圖解、推理與檢核證據；每一步均為原創教育任務。
stages.routeEn: Complete the prerequisites, then submit diagrams, reasoning and review evidence; each step is an original educational exercise.

steps.title: 建立非人體測試物的品質計畫
steps.titleEn: Plan quality checks using non-patient objects
steps.objective: 讓性能主張對應可重現物件。
